chapters.title: Chapter 121 | Sorting Out Rewards
paragraphs: The Eternal Buddha Endurance Scripture had upgraded to a Tier-7 technique, officially renamed the Indestructible Buddha Endurance Scripture.
The stages of the technique remained the same, but their effects had been magnified terrifyingly.
The first stage, Iron Flesh, had previously made his skin as hard as steel. Now, his flesh was tightened and strengthened until it was vastly superior to refined steel.
The second stage which was Iron Bones, had drastically increased his bone density and strength.
Right now, he was currently at the third stage, the Golden Organs.
At this moment, he could feel his internal organs hardening, taking on a lustrous, gold-like resilience.

The chronic pain he continuously absorbed from Mira, Lyra, and Selene was actively tempering his organs. He could feel that he was on the edge of breaking through to the fourth stage. It wouldn’t be long now.
But it was the evolution of his second body art that truly caught his attention. The Extreme Slaughter Demon Body had evolved into the Asura Slaughter Demon Body.
Dexter frowned, rubbing his temples.
The technique actually bordered on evil.
The Asura Slaughter Demon Body was not like other body tempering techniques, it was extremely terrifying.
A practitioner of this art could possess the physical strength of a Transcendent Realm expert while their mana cultivation lagged far behind.
But the cost was steep.
The technique relied on something called slaughter Energy and it can only be harvested from a freshly killed corpse.

According to the technique, slaughter energy existed within a dying body for only the first ten to fifteen minutes after death. Human or beast, it didn’t matter. The moment a life was extinguished, the energy began to dissipate, vanishing completely within a quarter of an hour.
If he wanted to cultivate this technique, he had to be the one whose hands ended the life, only then could the slaughter energy be absorbed.
Asura Slaughter Demon Body

Description: A forbidden body refinement art that tempers the flesh through slaughter. Unlike ordinary body cultivation techniques that rely on mana, the Asura Slaughter Body evolves the body itself. Every kill strengthens the host’s muscles, bones, blood, organs, and meridians, gradually transforming them into the physique of a true Asura.*
Cultivation Requirements:
• 10 kills — Meta Stage
• 100 kills — Superhuman Stage
• 1,000 kills — Ultra Realm
• 10,000 kills — Transcendent Realm
• 100,000 kills — Peak Transcendent Realm
• 1,000,000 kills — Supreme Realm
• 10,000,000 kills — Mid Supreme Realm
• 100,000,000 kills — Peak Supreme Realm
• 1,000,000,000 kills — Legendary
Dexter eyes widened in surprise. ’This technique is actually this terrifying?’
It actually possess a way to become a Legendary expert by simply killing.
One million kills for the Supreme Realm. One hundred million for Peak Supreme. One billion for Legendary.
He knew that if this technique fell into the wrong hands, the world would definitely burn.
There were people in this city, in this country, on this continent who would willingly sacrifice a hundred million lives to reach the Transcendent Realm not to mention Legendary.
If Dexter had not met the girls and had come across this technique, he wouldn’t hesitate either.
Before the marriage and the system, Dexter’s life had been cold and bitter. Treated as a slave by his own family.
Another darker truth was that the Assassins on the bridge weren’t his first kill either.
But now...
Now he didn’t hesitate either. The world be damned. If it’s to burn the entire city down or wipe the entire Ashford family become a Legend rank hero, he wouldn’t hesitate.
The Frost, Callowell and Vance family would be added bonus.
But the technique did not specify human kills.
Which meant that the slaughter energy could be harvested from any living creature that possessed life force.
Dexter’s ran his tongue across his lips.
Dungeons, he could head into a dungeon and clear the monsters there.
One thousand kills for the Ultra Realm was achievable within a month.
Ten thousand kills for the Transcendent Realm—achievable within three to five months.
One hundred thousand kills for Peak Transcendent—achievable within three to a year to two years of relentless dungeon raiding.
A Peak Transcendent Realm expert in two years.
Dexter leaned back as he smiled smirked.
Others spent 500 to 1000 years to reach the Transcendent Realm with mountains of resources, and dungeon raiding
But with this technique, he could do it in a year or two!
In the entire city, the number of Transcendent Realm experts could be counted on one hand. A Peak Transcendent could do whatever they wanted in the city with not many people that could stop them.
Dexter smiled. ’Now with my energy cultivation and body cultivation, things would be even simpler.’
With the extraction ability, his physique was alredy strong. Now with the body refinement art, he would be unstoppable.
He moved on to the next reward.
The Vibrum Skybreaker — Type-6 Arcane SUV
Dexter was genuinely excited as he pulled up the vehicle’s specifications.
The most remarkable thing about the vehicle was its appearance. Despite being a Type-6 combat-grade vehicle with enough firepower to level a district, it looked.l very ordinary.
From the outside, it was indistinguishable from a standard family SUV.
But on the inside, it was a fortress. Armor plating that could tank a hit from a Transcendent Realm expert. Hidden jet thrusters that enabled full flight.
An ultra-speed engine that could outrun a Peak Ultra Realm expert and an explosive mana cannon concealed that could severely injure an Ultra Realm expert and threaten an early Transcendent, etc.
Dexter grinned. His fear of being sniped through the window vanished.
Three Type-3 Arcane Smart Devices
Dexter shrugged at the phones. They were useful, certainly, but less thrilling than a flying armored SUV. The unlimited internet and calling access was a nice perk.
Grade-3 Eternal Frost Suppressant Serums 30x
Dexter immediately sighed in relief.
With the serum, Selene wouldn’t break out in seven months.
As for the Ancient Primordial Beast Egg reduction to 90%.
Dexter was excited about it.
’What kind of beast was inside? A dragon? A phoenix? Or something even better?’

One hundred thousand kills for Peak Transcendent—achievable within three to a year to two years of relentless dungeon raiding.
A Peak Transcendent Realm expert in two years.
Dexter leaned back as he smiled smirked.
Others spent 500 to 1000 years to reach the Transcendent Realm with mountains of resources, and dungeon raiding
But with this technique, he could do it in a year or two!
In the entire city, the number of Transcendent Realm experts could be counted on one hand.
A Peak Transcendent could do whatever they wanted in the city with not many people that could stop them.
Dexter smiled. ’Now with my energy cultivation and body cultivation, things would be even simpler.’
With the extraction ability, his physique was alredy strong.
Now with the body refinement art, he would be unstoppable.
He moved on to the next reward.
The Vibrum Skybreaker — Type-6 Arcane SUV
Dexter was genuinely excited as he pulled up the vehicle’s specifications.
The most remarkable thing about the vehicle was its appearance.
Despite being a Type-6 combat-grade vehicle with enough firepower to level a district, it looked.l very ordinary.
From the outside, it was indistinguishable from a standard family SUV.
But on the inside, it was a fortress.
Armor plating that could tank a hit from a Transcendent Realm expert.
Hidden jet thrusters that enabled full flight.
An ultra-speed engine that could outrun a Peak Ultra Realm expert and an explosive mana cannon concealed that could severely injure an Ultra Realm expert and threaten an early Transcendent, etc.
Dexter grinned.
His fear of being sniped through the window vanished.
Three Type-3 Arcane Smart Devices
Dexter shrugged at the phones.
They were useful, certainly, but less thrilling than a flying armored SUV.
The unlimited internet and calling access was a nice perk.
Grade-3 Eternal Frost Suppressant Serums 30x
Dexter immediately sighed in relief.
With the serum, Selene wouldn’t break out in seven months.
As for the Ancient Primordial Beast Egg reduction to 90%.
Dexter was excited about it.
’What kind of beast was inside?
A dragon?
A phoenix?
Or something even better?’

chapters.title: Chapter 122 | Abyssal Emperor Demon Bloodline
paragraphs: Dexter’s eyes drifted to the rice reward.
’One hundred kilograms of Diamond Spirit Rice?’
He rolled his eyes.
’I already have 1,100 kilograms sitting in my system storage from previous rewards. I haven’t even touched most of them yet.’
If the system really wanted to impress him, it could have dropped 10,000 kilograms.
He moved on, and his gaze landed on the next reward, and his pupils constricted.
[Fusion Available]
Would you like to fuse the following flames?
• Heavenly Flame: Emperor Void Flame (9th Heavenly Flame)
• Golden Flame Talent ( C-rank)
• Demonic Flame: Chaos Flame Demon Bloodline (Ancient Grade)
Fusion Result: Abyssal Emperor Flame Demon Bloodline
Flame Rank: 6th Heavenly Flame in the Flame Rankings
Dexter frowned as he remembered something from Selene’s status.
According to the system’s diagnosis, there were only two known methods to save her:
1. Locate a Grade-7 Heavenly Treasure called the Ice Warm Cocoon.
2. Acquire the Abyssal Demon Heart Flame—a legendary flame capable of slowly melting the Eternal Winter Ice without harming her physical organs.
But now, the system was offering him something called the Abyssal Emperor Flame.
Not the Abyssal Demon Heart Flame. The Abyssal Emperor Flame.
Dexter’s heart skipped a beat.
’What was the difference?’

The Abyssal Demon Heart Flame was born in the deepest trenches of the Demon Abyss. But the Abyssal Emperor Flame was the product of fusing a 9th Heavenly Flame, a golden flame talent, along with an Ancient Grade bloodline with flame ability.
If the Abyssal Demon Heart Flame could cure Selene... what could the Abyssal Emperor Flame do?
Dexter did not hesitate.
"Fuse.
[Fusion Progress: 0%]
The moment said ’fuse’, his body instantly erupted with energy.
The Chaos Flame Demon Bloodline surged from deep within his DNA, igniting like a chain of volcanoes detonating simultaneously along every strand of his genetic code.
"RUMBLE!"
At the same time, the Emperor Void Flame blazed to life within his inner universe, roaring with a fury that shook his entire body.
[Fusion Progress: 2%]
The easiest was the Golden Flame talent. It was incredibly cooperative with two powerful flames suppressing it.
His veins popped beneath his skin, glowing a deep, molten crimson light that pulsed beneath the surface of his flesh as though his blood had turned into pure magma.
[Fusion Progress: 5%]
His veins lit up like rivers of fire coursing beneath transparent skin, painting his body in a web of burning, volcanic light.
Simultaneously, the Emperor Void Flame escaped his inner universe and came out to his physical body.
[Fusion Progress: 7%]
It suddenly spread outward like a golden flood, surging through his meridians, merging into his muscles, seeping into his bones as it merged with his bloodline.
The three flames collided inside him.
[Fusion Progress: 10%]
Dexter grunted as sweat started to drip off him rapidly.
The heat was indescribable, and it felt as though he was being cooked from the inside out! Not just that, he felt his soul was being stir fried!

The divine purity of the Emperor Void Flame, the silent Golden Flame, and the ancient, chaotic violence of the Chaos Flame Demon Bloodline clashed like three hurricanes spinning in opposite directions as they turned to emerge with each other.
[Fusion Progress: 20%]
Those two flames didn’t even merge when he tried to fuse them, and now they were being fused inside of him.
His expression changed drastically.
’This might have been a mistake.’

At that moment, the pain escalated beyond anything he had anticipated. It was ten times worse than the girls pain. This was raw, primordial agony. The three flames were tearing him apart and rebuilding him simultaneously.
[Fusion Progress: 30%]
Dexter’s quickly brought out the Tranquility Bracelet—one of the calming relics he had purchased for the girls—and slapped it onto his wrist.
A cool, soothing pulse spread through his nervous system, but it was barely helping!
It was like throwing stones into a still lake! It had no effect apart from ripples!
"Hmph!"

Dexter grunted in pain, and he tried his best not to scream and disturb the girls. But the pain he was feeling was just too painful. He had to bite down his lips, causing blood to drop on his white bed sheet.
’Why didn’t the system warn that it would be impossibly painful?’
Dexter roared in his mind as the pain started to reach a whole new threshold!
[Fusion Progress: 45%]
At that moment, the bed beneath his body started to burn rapidly, and in just half a second, it had silently disintegrated beneath him due to the heat from the violent reaction.
The Cloud Weaver bed evaporated into ash by the three flames.
Even the ash was consumed so thoroughly that not a single trace remained.
Dexter crashed to the floor.
He grunted in pain as his bare skin struck the wooden floorboards.
Suddenly, tears started to stream down his eyes.
However, the tears were not ordinary tears. They were crimson and thick, like blood but a thick, viscous blood.
If one looked at it, they would notice the blood glowing slightly as the blood tears ran down his cheeks. He was crying blood.
And it wasn’t just his eyes.
His pores began to turn bloody as blood came out of his pores.
That wasn’t all; his body was bleeding from every opening. His nose, his mouth, his ears rang with a high-pitched whine as warm liquid trickled from them.
The fusion progress climbed.
Dexter felt his consciousness fraying. The pain had transcended physical sensation and entered a realm of suffering that existed somewhere between life and death.

His body was being unmade and reforged at the same time, every cell destroyed and reborn in an endless, agonizing cycle, and at this moment, he knew if he didn’t do anything, he would definitely fall unconscious.
He remembered the pain medication he had taken after purchasing a pain relief for the girls. His shaking hand fumbled into his storage ring, withdrawing the Grade-2 Pain Alleviation Pill.

chapters.title: Chapter 123 | Handsome Appearance!
paragraphs: The pill dissolved instantly. A wave of numbing coolness spread through his body, wrapping around his screaming nerves like a bandage.
But it wasn’t enough!
Dexter felt his limit approaching.

The fusion was consuming him. If he lost consciousness now for even a single second, the flames would consume him entirely. There would be nothing left but ash and a lingering trail of fire. No body. No soul. No Dexter.
The faces of Mira, Lyra, and Selene flashed through his mind.
Mira, laughing in the rain, her red hair plastered to her face, her spectral arms scooping water like a child playing in a puddle.
Lyra, blushing furiously as her telepathic voice whispered thank you inside his mind, her dark eyes shining with quiet gratitude.
Selene, clinging to his arm in the kitchen, her cold body pressed against his, purring softly as his warmth seeped into her frozen bones.
’I can’t leave them.’
The thought hit him with the force of lightning.
If he died here, alone, on the floor of his bedroom, consumed by his own ambition, Mira would never walk again. Lyra would never speak with her own voice as the shadow corruption takes place.
Selene would freeze to death, slowly and painfully, her ice consuming her from the inside out.
Their zeal might collapse, and they might actually become suicidal once more.
They had no one, no family, no protection. He was their only family, and if he died right here, it would be over for them.
’No!’
Dexter clenched his teeth hard as his fingers cracked through the tilted ground like it was made of paper as he squeezed hard on the earth.
’i refuse to die just like this!’
The fusion process continued.
Dexter’s vision faded and turned blurry as the edges of his consciousness dissolved into white static.
He could feel the last threads of his awareness slipping through his fingers like sand.
’Hold on! Hold on! Hold on!’
Dexter roared like a beast to himself!
[Fusion Progress: 99%]
The world suddenly went blank.
Everything, including the pain, the heat, and the trembling body, stopped as it all went silent.
Then—
[Fusion Completed: 100%]
BOOM.
A shockwave of abyssal violet fire erupted from Dexter’s body, scorching the ground black
The walls cracked, windows shattered outward, sending glass fragments into the night. The ceiling above him was also charred and burnt.
At that moment, Dexter collapsed to the ground, unconscious.
His body lay motionless on the scorched floor, surrounded by a faint aura of deep violet flame that flickered and then faded into nothing.
Beep. Beep. Beep.
The shrill, electronic tone cut through the fog of unconsciousness like a knife.
Dexter’s eyes fluttered open. And saw it was the alarm he had set it to remind him to take Mira to the bathroom before dinner.
He groaned as he felt every muscle in his body felt like it had been run through a meat grinder. His joints ached. His skin tingled with residual heat.
He pushed himself up slowly, blinking against the dim light of his bedroom. Then he looked down.
His clothes were gone and burned away entirely, as though they weren’t there in the first place, as he stood there completely naked.
But that wasn’t what made him stare.
His entire body was covered in a thick, black, foul-smelling goo.
It coated his skin from head to toe, including his face.
But the worst of it was that it was freaking horrible.
The stench was indescribable. It was the concentrated essence of every impurity, toxin, and accumulated waste product that had been locked inside his body for years—purged in a single day.
Dexter lifted his hand and watched the black sludge drip slowly from his fingers, landing on the scorched floorboards with a wet splat.
"...Gross."
He stood up unsteadily like Mia Khalifa does most of the time.
His nose wrinkled in disgust as he felt his body trembling in irritation.
’So freaking disgusting!’
Suddenly, he felt something new within his body. It was similar to suddenly realizing you’ve grown a tail. He knew it was the Abyssal Emperor Flames
He paused as he looked at his hands, then he closed his eyes for a moment.
Suddenly, a thin tendril of deep violet flame materialized above his palm.
It was incredibly beautiful. It had a violet core and two layers of white and gold at the edge.
The Abyssal Emperor Flame, the 6th Heavenly Flame.
And somewhere in the backyard, deep inside Selene’s broken body, the Eternal Winter Ice trembled.
Dexter extinguished the flame and headed for the shower. He couldn’t handle the gooey substance all over his body.
The grime coating his body was thick and stubborn.
He grabbed a fresh bar of soap and desperately washed his body as the water gushing down his body changed to a deep black and crimson color.
By the time he was done an hour had gone by.
He had washed himself 4 times before the water turned clear.
As he rinsed the last traces of sludge from his hair, he happened to glance up at the small, foggy mirror mounted in the shower stall.
Dexter immediately did a double-take as he stared at the stranger in the mirror.
’Who’s that?’
Dexter wasn’t the type of person that looked in the mirror.
’Wait, is that... me?’
He already knew how ordinary he was, so he didn’t need the everyday reminder of the fact.
He had always showered every morning and never bothered to check his appearance because of how busy he was with himself and the girls.
It had been months, possibly two months or more since he had last properly looked at his own face.
And right now, the face staring back at him from the foggy glass was not the face he remembered.
Dexter had never considered himself ugly, but he was quite ordinary even more so amongst ordinary people.
His chin had been meaty, his cheeks round and his head not a perfect symmetry.
Years of cheap alcohol during his time at the Ashford estate had added an extra puffiness to his face, making him look tired and slightly bloated
The only thing remotely distinctive about him had been his hair.
He kept it long, because he couldn’t afford salon visits.
In the Ashford estate, he had been paid a servant’s wage. Haircuts were an unnecessary expense.
He could simply cut his hair with a pair of scissors whenever there was a chance.
Even after leaving the Ashfords and coming into money, he had simply forgotten about his hair, and he usually tied it back in a loose ponytail or let it hang loose depending on his mood.
But the face in the mirror...

chapters.title: Chapter 124 | Lord Have Mercy & Strange Dinner
paragraphs: But the face in the mirror... was handsome?
His jaw has actually become chiseled. The soft, rounded edges of his former face was gone, replaced by sharp, angular lines that looked like they were carved out from stones!
His cheekbones looked nice too and the baby fat was completely gone without a single trace left.
And his eyes were still their normal brown, however from certain angle, they seemed dark red instead.
Dexter was stunned and he subconsciously leaned closer to the mirror, his breath fogging the glass further as he glanced at the stranger in the mirror.
’What the actual hell?’
He could barely recognize himself!
His brows scrunched in disbelief when his eyes suddenly caught sight of his stomach.

He looked down at his body and was faced with a perfect grid six packs. He hadn’t even hardened his muscles yet but they were there as though he was born with it. And it wasn’t just 6 packs but seemed more like 10 packs.
He looked further down and his eyes widened.
’Lord have mercy.’
Dexter speechlessly removed his gaze and focused on the golden markings on his arms and neck.
They looked like tattoos, covering his chest, neck, arms and shoulders.
’Seems like the merging did more than create another bloodline.’
He frowned as he gazed at the tattoo around his skin

The merging of the Emperor Void Flame, The Golden Flame along with his Chaos Flame Demon Bloodline must have imprinted these marks onto his body as a byproduct of the union divine and demonic energy permanently branding his flesh.
’Sigh. Mira will certainly enjoy mocking me if she saw this.’
He could already imagine the conversation.
Mira: "Hehe. Anything to look handsome right?"
Selene: "..."
Lyra: "Are there more pastries?"
Dexter groaned internally. How was he to explain the sudden emergence of tattoo overnight. But he felt like he might be overreacting, the girls might not even care about it.
At that moment, the golden markings k. His body started to fade.
Within seconds, the runes had retreated entirely beneath the surface of his skin, as though they had never existed.
Dexter raised an eyebrow but shrugged.
"I’m definitely not complaining."
He turned off the shower, dried himself, and returned to his bedroom.
Dexter dressed in a dark t-shirt and joggers as he glanced at the clock.
’One hour behind schedule.’
He should have started cooking an hour ago.

Dexter entered the kitchen and assessed his options. He briefly considered skipping a proper meal and simply serving tea with the Celestial Moon Pastries. It would be quick, easy, and the pastries’ cultivation-boosting effects would benefit the girls during their midnight meditation.
But he shook his head. The girls were still thin, they needed a proper meal to end the day.
The question was what should he cook.
Dexter stood before the refrigerator, contemplating.
He pulled out vegetables, herbs, eggs, spices, fruits, and a thick cut of steak from the market.
Nothing extravagant.
He tied on his apron, activated his newly awakened Abyssal Emperor Flame, and began cooking with the Type II pot.
Even with ordinary ingredients, his Great Grandmaster Foodsmith skills transformed them into culinary masterpieces.

His control over the crimson flames was even more astonishing. At his command, they danced through the air, weaving into lifelike dragons, phoenixes, and blooming flowers before gently enveloping the ingredients without burning them.

Forty minutes later, a sumptuous feast sat on the table; a perfectly flame-seared herb steak accompanied by butter-glazed vegetables, a fluffy herb omelet, and a vibrant fruit medley, all infused with rich spiritual energy.
[Ding! Congratulations! You have successfully prepared a Grade-Two Spiritual Meal!]
[Effects:]
• Recovers physical stamina and soothes muscle fatigue.
• Increases cultivation speed by 30% for four hours.
•Increased libido by 200%
• Reduces friction during breakthroughs, making it easier to advance from one level to another.
• Calms the nervous system and promotes deep, restorative sleep.
Dexter nodded in satisfaction. A Grade-Two meal from ordinary grocery store ingredients.
It seemed like he didn’t actually read through the effect.
He set the dining table: four bowls, four spoons, four cups of tea, arranged them neatly and turned toward the living room to call the girls—
Lyra was already standing at the kitchen entrance, a fork and knife clutched in each hand as her dark eyes locked in the food, almost drooling.
Dexter chuckled. "You could have helped me set the table, you know."
Lyra’s cheeks flushed slightly but she didn’t put down the fork. Dexter sighed as he shook his head.
Selene was still in the backyard so he went to the backyard and found her sitting cross-legged beneath the overhang with hee eyes closed as she cultivated.
The rain had stopped and the sky was clear as the moonlight illuminated her silver hair, making her look like a goddess who had just descended to the mortal world.
She looked incredibly peaceful and also extremely beautiful. Dexter immediately inhaled sharply, calming himself as he called out softly.
"Selene, dinner is ready."
Her ears trembled as the vibration called out everything around her.

She opened her eyes, nodded, and stood up gracefully. She walked toward him without hesitation, her feet was bare but she didn’t seem cold as she entered the kitchen and took her usual spot beside Lyra.
Her hand found the spoon on the table without fumbling as her fingers easily wrapped around it the handle.
Mira was still sound asleep in the bedroom so rather than wake her up, Dexter decided to save her portion.
He placed her covered plate inside the microwave for whenever she woke up.
At the dinner table, Lyra was practically inhaling her food.
Selene ate quietly beside her with her eyes closed.
’Hm?’
Dexter felt like he was being watched. He looked at Lyra but she was drinking her food and Selene eyes was closed as she also focused on her meal.
However, Dexter couldn’t shake the feeling of being watched. Whicj only left one person, Selene. She doesn’t rely on her eyes but her ears.
Dexter could feel she was focusing entirely on him, mapping his body and the mana radiating from him with pinpoint precision.
He glanced up at her, but Selene was expressionless as she continued eating.
Dexter frowned slightly but shrugged it off.
Maybe she wanted something but didn’t know how to ask, or maybe she was waiting for Lyra to leave. He decided not to press the issue.
A few minutes later, Lyra scraped her bowl clean. She let out a satisfied sigh with cheeks flushed as she drank two glass full of water. Her massive chest rising and falling at the movement.
’Good night,’her soft, melodic voice echoed in everyone’s mind.

Selene froze for a moment. She slowly shook her head, but then hesitated, and slowly nodded.
"Did you... do something?" she asked quietly.
Dexter frowned, confused. "What do you mean?"

His jaw has actually become chiseled.
The soft, rounded edges of his former face was gone, replaced by sharp, angular lines that looked like they were carved out from stones!
His cheekbones looked nice too and the baby fat was completely gone without a single trace left.
And his eyes were still their normal brown, however from certain angle, they seemed dark red instead.
Dexter was stunned and he subconsciously leaned closer to the mirror, his breath fogging the glass further as he glanced at the stranger in the mirror.
’What the actual hell?’
He could barely recognize himself!
His brows scrunched in disbelief when his eyes suddenly caught sight of his stomach.
He looked down at his body and was faced with a perfect grid six packs.
He hadn’t even hardened his muscles yet but they were there as though he was born with it.
And it wasn’t just 6 packs but seemed more like 10 packs.
He looked further down and his eyes widened.
’Lord have mercy.’
Dexter speechlessly removed his gaze and focused on the golden markings on his arms and neck.
They looked like tattoos, covering his chest, neck, arms and shoulders.
’Seems like the merging did more than create another bloodline.’
He frowned as he gazed at the tattoo around his skin

The merging of the Emperor Void Flame, The Golden Flame along with his Chaos Flame Demon Bloodline must have imprinted these marks onto his body as a byproduct of the union divine and demonic energy permanently branding his flesh.
’Sigh.
Mira will certainly enjoy mocking me if she saw this.’

Mira: "Hehe.
Anything to look handsome right?"

How was he to explain the sudden emergence of tattoo overnight.

At that moment, the golden markings k.

Nothing extravagant.

A Grade-Two meal from ordinary grocery store ingredients.

chapters.title: Chapter 125 | Mira & Dexter Almost...
paragraphs: "What happened to you?" she asked quietly.
Selene’s brows slightly furrowed. "I meant... Did something happen to you?"

Dexter blinked, suddenly remembering that he had broken through to the seventh stage of the Superhuman Realm earlier that evening. He smiled, trying to play it off. "Oh, I just had a breakthrough. That’s probably what you’re feeling. It’s normal for your senses to pick up a shift in mana when someone advances."
Selene remained silent for a long moment as she pondered but then, she slowly shook her head.
"No, that’s not it," she said firmly. "What did you do?"
Dexter’s smile faded. "What do you mean?"

"Previously, you were like a burning flame. But right now... all I can see is a... wildfire. Your aura has changed. It’s still calm but is extremely aggressive. Did you take any strength enhancing drug? You should know not to take those things.
Selene said with a frown as she warned him.
Dexter was stunned.
He hadn’t expected Selene’s senses to be so perceptive that she could actually see the shift in his bloodline.
He tried thinking of a reply but couldn’t come up with a plausible response.
Finally, he simply shrugged as he said casually.
"Maybe my body is just evolving and getting used to the changes. That happens sometimes when you break through."
He then changed the subject. "You should go inside and rest. After all, you’ve been cultivating all day. Even if your body is willing, your mind needs to rest."
He didn’t wait for her to respond as he stood up, gathered the plates, and took them to the sink. The sound of running water and clinking sound of the plates filled the silence.

Even with his back turned, he could still feel Selene’s focus on him. She didn’t remained there for about ten minutes, before she eventually stood up and quietly retreated to the bedroom to join Lyra.
’Are all my wives this scary? Sigh, Lyra is still the only cute one.’
Dexter sighed in relief, dried his hands, undid his apron, and went to the living room.
He flipped his palm and a Matrix core appeared in his palm. It was the Tier 6 Guardian Matrix Formation.
He took almost an hour to set the formation up and eventually he got it and then activated it.
Another invincible barrier appeared around the Ashford home, making two protective barriers.
At this rate, even a Peak Transcendent would have difficulty entering the Ashford compound.
Satisfied, he went back to his room to resume cultivating.
3’o clock AM.
The bungalow was silent but there were a few insect noises occasionally breaking the quiet.
Inside his room, Dexter sat cross-legged on his bed, quietly cultivating as mana surged directly into inner universe, filling up his 7th star nodes.
Suddenly, his eyes snapped open.
"Squeak..."
His enhanced hearing immediately picked up the faint sound and it was coming from the hallway.
Mira.
Dexter smiled helplessly.

She was trying her best to move quietly, but the wheelchair she used was old. Every movement of its worn wheels produced an unmistakable squeaking sound. In the silence of midnight, it was impossible to hide.
He already knew what she was doing.
Without making a sound, Dexter stood up and stepped out of his room.
Sure enough, Mira was slowly making her way toward the kitchen. Using her Spectral Arms, she carefully pushed the wheelchair forward, moving much more skillfully than she had a few days ago.
Hearing the bedroom door open, Mira turned her neck around.
Their eyes met.
She blinked once, her face expressionless, then simply turned away and continued toward the kitchen as if she hadn’t seen him.
Dexter couldn’t help but chuckle.
Without saying a word, he walked behind her and gently took hold of the wheelchair handles.
Mira didn’t protest.
Silence accompanied them as Dexter slowly pushed her into the dining room.
He stopped beside the table and positioned her where she usually sat.
Then he walked into the kitchen.
He reheated the food he had prepared earlier, arranged it neatly on a plate, placed a spoon beside it, and carried everything back.
He gently placed the meal before her.
"...Thank you," Mira muttered quietly.
One of her Spectral Arms picked up the spoon as she started to feed herself.
Compared to before, her movements were noticeably smoother. She no longer struggled with every motion, and feeding herself had become much faster.
Dexter watched quietly.
After taking several bites, Mira noticed he was still standing there.
She frowned.
"What? Is it fun watching the crippled girl struggle to eat? You can go back to sleep now. Thank you for your help."
Dexter suppressed his chuckle and shrugged. "I still have to wash the dishes."
He pointed toward the sink.
"If dirty plates are left overnight, they’ll attract cockroaches and other insects."
Then he looked at her with an innocent smile.
"You don’t want a cockroach wandering into your room, do you?"
Mira’s expression immediately changed.
She glared at him, knowing fully well he was implying something.
"Do you think I’m scared of a mere cockroach?" she shot back.
Dexter fought back a grin. "I’m just saying..."
He leaned slightly closer.
"So if you suddenly found one crawling onto your bed..."
"...or hiding underneath your pillow, you wouldn’t be scared, right?"
Mira glared at him.
"You better not have any stupid ideas. I’m warning you."
Dexter immediately raised both hands in surrender.
"Relax. I was joking."
Mira let out an annoyed huff before returning to her meal.
Knowing she would be uncomfortable with him standing there watching her, Dexter went back to his room as he resumed cultivating.
Even with his eyes closed, his enhanced hearing remained focused on the dining room.
The faint clinking of the spoon against the ceramic plate continued for several minutes.
Eventually, there was silence.
Dexter smiled.
He stood and walked back into the dining room almost immediately.
Seeing him appear almost instantaneously, Mira chuckled. "You will make a perfect stalker, you pervert."
Dexter burst into laughter.
The sound echoed throughout the otherwise quiet bungalow.
Mira simply sighed and shook her head.
"Hmph."
Still smiling, Dexter wheeled her back toward the bedroom.
Once inside, he locked the wheelchair before carefully sliding one arm beneath her knees and the other around her back.
He lifted her effortlessly.
Mira body uncontrollably leaned against him.
As he carried her toward the bed, the top of her head rested lightly against his chest.
Then—
Her lips accidentally brushed against the side of his neck.
At that exact moment, Dexter’s entire body stiffened and his heart actually skipped a beat!
Almost unconsciously, he lowered his gaze but at that exact moment, Mira looked up at him, their faces 3 inches away from each other and their lips just 3 centimeters away from each other!
Both of them stiffened as their breathing froze as they gazed into each others eyes, neither of them spoke.
Time itself seemed to slow.
Dexter found himself lowering his gaze as he stared ar her her soft, rosy lips.
For a brief, dangerous moment...
An overwhelming urge he couldn’t control possessed him. And at that moment, his one true wish at that moment was to consume those sumptuous lips and kiss her deeply.
The temptation came so suddenly that it caught him completely off guard.
Just as he leaned a fraction of a centimeter, the Serenity Band around his wrist emitted a faint calming warmth.
Instantly, a cool sensation washed over Dexter’s body and the hotness he was feeling calmed down. helping him regain control before he could do anything stupid.
He slowly looked away.
Mira’s cheeks had already turned a delicate shade of red and she hadn’t said a single word.
Dexter pretended as though what he had almost done wasn’t him.
He carefully laid her onto the bed, adjusted the pillow beneath her head, and gently pulled the duvet over her body.
"...Goodnight," he said, his voice husky.
Without waiting for a response, Dexter turned and quickly left the room.

chapters.title: Chapter 126 | Don’t Go!
paragraphs: The next morning, Dexter woke up early, freshened up, and went through his routine. He took care of Mira, and both of them pretended as though the midnight event didn’t happen as Dexter finished up with her, dressing her up in a cloth she liked.
He had figured out the root of the problem. One of the herbs he used to make dinner last night gave a slight unwanted effect, which was definitely the reason for everything.
He sighed in relief and headed to the kitchen to cook breakfast.
The four of them were seated at the dining table, eating in comfortable silence, when it happened.
’Ding! Ding! Ding!’
Dexter’s phone suddenly erupted with a loud, blaring alarm—a sound he had never heard before.
Startled, he pulled the device from his pocket and stared at the screen. A bright red banner flashed across the display.
[EMERGENCY ALERT]
[F-Rank Hero: Dexter Ashford]
[Please rush to this location immediately to assist!]
[A Gate has appeared and a Monster Outbreak Detected]
[Estimated Gate: F-Rank to E-Rank]
[Based on your current location, you are the closest registered hero. Estimated arrival time: Under 3 minutes.]
[Please hurry! Every second wasted could cost a civilian life!]
Dexter’s eyes widened. It hadn’t even been three days since he had registered at the Hero Association, and he was already being dispatched to a monster outbreak.
Just as Dexter was about to push his chair back, a cold voice cut through the morning air.
"Don’t."
Dexter was startled as he looked up in surprise. He could see Selene glaring at his phone, her white eyes staring at him with furrowed brows.
"You’re not going."
This time, Mira spoke in a firm tone as she glared at the phone in his hand.
Dexter scratched the back of his head as he frowned. He was a registered hero now, and a part of the Hero Association.

He received a monthly stipend, and that came with obligations. He couldn’t simply ignore an emergency dispatch. Worse, the alert had explicitly stated that every second wasted could cost a civilian life.
If the Association tracked his GPS, they would know he had received the alert and chosen not to respond.
He glanced sideways and saw Lyra was also glaring at his phone.
The three girls’ faces had turned cold by now.
’It seems the trauma from the dungeon still haunts all three of them.’
Anything related to monsters, outbreaks, or dungeons triggered a deep, visceral fear that Dexter understood completely.
But he needed kills, not just for the Asura Slaughter Demon Body, but to upgrade the investment multiplier from 100x to 1,000x.
Right now. He needed 51 more kills to hit the 1,000x milestone for that; he would need to head into dungeons, go for more monster outbreaks, not just for the system but also for the girls.
If he wanted to find a cure for them, he would head into Dungeons more often than they would be comfortable with. As for the civilians, Dexter wasn’t too keen on saving them.
But he had just reconciled with Mira, if he left now, all of that progress might crumble and Selene and Lyra might just hate him for it.
Dexter’s brows tightened even further
Mira watched the struggle play across his face. The conflict in his eyes was unmistakable

As she gazed at him, her furrowed brows started to ease, and her gaze eventually softened. Because Mira understood something in that moment, something that cut through her fear and her trauma and her selfish desire to keep him safe within arm’s reach.
Dexter was a good person by nature.
If he weren’t, he would never accept taking care of a cripple, but he took on three instead.
If he wasn’t a good person, he could have ignored them, brought in several women into their home, or even had other girls on the side.
But he hasn’t done that. He has stuck with them, made sure they didn’t starve or lack anything, endured their insults, absorbed their pain, and never once complained.
He had pushed a wheelchair into the rain just to make her smile, spent hundreds of thousands of dollars or even millions not because he had to, but because he wanted to.
If she told him not to go, if she forced him to sit here while people died while he might listen, he would have to suppress that good part of himself that needed to save innocent lives.
And in doing so, she would be forcing him to go against his nature, changing him, twisting his good heart into something else until eventually he might just stop caring entirely.
Mira sighed internally, and her face shifted as it went from being fierce to indifferent.
"Just go if you want to go," she said flatly.
Dexter, still locked in his internal debate, was stunned as he turned toward her.
Lyra and Selene’s eyes widened as they turned towards Selene in surprise.
Mira turned her head away, refusing to meet his eyes. "When did you start listening to us?"
"Since you really want to go, just go."
Her gaze suddenly turned cold as she glared at him. "If you like, get yourself killed and don’t come back. I am going to haunt your soul."
Dexter stared at her, stunned. ’She’s really serious.’
Mira, feeling the intensity of his gaze, rolled her eyes. Two spectral arms materialized behind her, one of them scooping up a spoonful of rice as she ignored him and continued eating.
Lyra and Selene’s brows were still furrowed. Selene’s fists were clenched, her nails almost digging into her palm.
Dexter smiled gently. "Don’t worry. I promise to come back." He paused, a hint of playfulness entering his voice.
"As you three keep pointing out, I apparently have a mysterious backing. So I’ll be fine."
Mira’s eyes snapped to him. "So you admit it," she said, her voice sharp. "You admit having a mysterious backing."
Dexter shrugged innocently. "I never said I did. I never said I didn’t."
Mira clicked her tongue and rolled her eyes, returning to her meal.
Dexter smiled as he turned to Selene and Lyra. But Lyra had resumed eating while Selene was staring at Mira with her white eyes.
Seemingly to have gotten their permission, he pushed back from the table and disappeared into his bedroom.
In under ten seconds, he had pulled a clean shirt over his wife-beater singlet, grabbed his shoes, and was at the front door.
He turned back to the girls. "I promise I will be back. Don’t open the door for anyone."
Mira snorted in irritation. "Not funny."
Dexter chuckled and waved goodbye, opened the door, and stepped out. The door closed behind him with a soft click.
The dining room fell silent.
Then Lyra and Selene’s gaze snapped toward Mira, their expressions hardening.
’Why did you do that?’
Lyra’s telepathic voice echoed inside Mira’s mind, and for the first time, the soft, melodic tone had turned cold. Dangerously cold.

Selene’s face was equally frigid. Her sightless eyes were narrowed, her jaw tight. "You shouldn’t have told him to go," she said quietly. "After what happened to us, monster outbreaks and dungeons should be the one thing we prevent him from walking into. Yet you let him go."
Mira finished chewing her bite, swallowed calmly, and set down her spoon.
"You two are also his wives," she replied evenly. "You could have told him to stay, and he would have listened."
Lyra rolled her eyes so hard it was almost audible.

Selene indifferently spoke. "We all know you are closer to him than either of us," she said. "He wouldn’t have listened to us. But if you had said something, regardless, he would have stayed. Just like he always does when it matters to you."
Mira blinked, and she found herself momentarily caught off guard. She glanced between the two girls, reading their expressions. Her eyes widened slightly in sudden realization.
A small smile crept across Mira’s lips. "Are you two... actually jealous?"
Lyra’s eyes blinked rapidly, and a slight flush crept up her neck to her cheeks. She immediately ate her last spoon and stood up, then announced into their minds: ’I’m done.’
She practically fled the dining room, leaving Mira and Selene alone at the table.
Selene, however, didn’t back down. She continued glaring at Mira without blinking, and her chin tilted upward in defiance.

Mira’s smirk widened. "Since you two are jealous, that means you are beginning to like him," she said casually. "Since you like him, why don’t you just tell him? I’m pretty sure it would make his day—two pretty girls confessing their feelings to him."
The silence that followed was deafening.
Selene’s lips pressed together tightly, but she didn’t flinch. Her pale, sightless eyes accurately locked on Mira’s eyes.
Mira’s smirk shifted into something more dangerous. She tilted her head slightly. "What? Do you truly want to fight for his attention with me?"
There was silence at first, but then Selene replied in a cold and indifferent tone. "I can try."

Mira’s smile widened further and then suddenly broke into a genuine, incredulous laugh. "Are we really about to quarrel because of a man?" She shook her head, her red hair swaying in disbelief. "I’m really fighting about a man."
Selene remained unblinking, unyielding, and she was dead serious.
Mira’s laughter faded. She studied Selene’s face for a long moment, searching for any trace of jest but there was non!
Mira frowned but then shrugged. "Fine. You can have him."
Selene held her gaze for three more seconds. Then, slowly, she lowered her head and resumed eating her breakfast in silence.
Mira’s brows remained furrowed, her eyes lingering on Selene for a few more seconds before she finally looked away.

sentences.text: The next morning, Dexter woke up early, freshened up, and went through his routine.
He took care of Mira, and both of them pretended as though the midnight event didn’t happen as Dexter finished up with her, dressing her up in a cloth she liked.
He had figured out the root of the problem.
One of the herbs he used to make dinner last night gave a slight unwanted effect, which was definitely the reason for everything.
He sighed in relief and headed to the kitchen to cook breakfast.
The four of them were seated at the dining table, eating in comfortable silence, when it happened.
’Ding!
Ding!
Ding!’
Dexter’s phone suddenly erupted with a loud, blaring alarm—a sound he had never heard before.
Startled, he pulled the device from his pocket and stared at the screen.
A bright red banner flashed across the display.
[EMERGENCY ALERT]
[F-Rank Hero: Dexter Ashford]
[Please rush to this location immediately to assist!]
[A Gate has appeared and a Monster Outbreak Detected]
[Estimated Gate: F-Rank to E-Rank]
[Based on your current location, you are the closest registered hero.
Estimated arrival time: Under 3 minutes.]
[Please hurry!
Every second wasted could cost a civilian life!]
Dexter’s eyes widened.
It hadn’t even been three days since he had registered at the Hero Association, and he was already being dispatched to a monster outbreak.
Just as Dexter was about to push his chair back, a cold voice cut through the morning air.
"Don’t."
Dexter was startled as he looked up in surprise.
He could see Selene glaring at his phone, her white eyes staring at him with furrowed brows.
"You’re not going."
This time, Mira spoke in a firm tone as she glared at the phone in his hand.
Dexter scratched the back of his head as he frowned.
He was a registered hero now, and a part of the Hero Association.
He received a monthly stipend, and that came with obligations.
He couldn’t simply ignore an emergency dispatch.
Worse, the alert had explicitly stated that every second wasted could cost a civilian life.
If the Association tracked his GPS, they would know he had received the alert and chosen not to respond.
He glanced sideways and saw Lyra was also glaring at his phone.
The three girls’ faces had turned cold by now.
’It seems the trauma from the dungeon still haunts all three of them.’
Anything related to monsters, outbreaks, or dungeons triggered a deep, visceral fear that Dexter understood completely.
But he needed kills, not just for the Asura Slaughter Demon Body, but to upgrade the investment multiplier from 100x to 1,000x.
Right now.
He needed 51 more kills to hit the 1,000x milestone for that; he would need to head into dungeons, go for more monster outbreaks, not just for the system but also for the girls.
If he wanted to find a cure for them, he would head into Dungeons more often than they would be comfortable with.
As for the civilians, Dexter wasn’t too keen on saving them.
But he had just reconciled with Mira, if he left now, all of that progress might crumble and Selene and Lyra might just hate him for it.
Dexter’s brows tightened even further
Mira watched the struggle play across his face.
The conflict in his eyes was unmistakable
As she gazed at him, her furrowed brows started to ease, and her gaze eventually softened.
Because Mira understood something in that moment, something that cut through her fear and her trauma and her selfish desire to keep him safe within arm’s reach.
Dexter was a good person by nature.
If he weren’t, he would never accept taking care of a cripple, but he took on three instead.
If he wasn’t a good person, he could have ignored them, brought in several women into their home, or even had other girls on the side.
But he hasn’t done that.
He has stuck with them, made sure they didn’t starve or lack anything, endured their insults, absorbed their pain, and never once complained.
He had pushed a wheelchair into the rain just to make her smile, spent hundreds of thousands of dollars or even millions not because he had to, but because he wanted to.
If she told him not to go, if she forced him to sit here while people died while he might listen, he would have to suppress that good part of himself that needed to save innocent lives.
And in doing so, she would be forcing him to go against his nature, changing him, twisting his good heart into something else until eventually he might just stop caring entirely.
Mira sighed internally, and her face shifted as it went from being fierce to indifferent.
"Just go if you want to go," she said flatly.
Dexter, still locked in his internal debate, was stunned as he turned toward her.
Lyra and Selene’s eyes widened as they turned towards Selene in surprise.
Mira turned her head away, refusing to meet his eyes.
"When did you start listening to us?"
"Since you really want to go, just go."
Her gaze suddenly turned cold as she glared at him.
"If you like, get yourself killed and don’t come back.
I am going to haunt your soul."
Dexter stared at her, stunned. ’She’s really serious.’
Mira, feeling the intensity of his gaze, rolled her eyes.
Two spectral arms materialized behind her, one of them scooping up a spoonful of rice as she ignored him and continued eating.
Lyra and Selene’s brows were still furrowed.
Selene’s fists were clenched, her nails almost digging into her palm.
Dexter smiled gently.
"Don’t worry.
I promise to come back." He paused, a hint of playfulness entering his voice.
"As you three keep pointing out, I apparently have a mysterious backing.
So I’ll be fine."
Mira’s eyes snapped to him.
"So you admit it," she said, her voice sharp.
"You admit having a mysterious backing."
Dexter shrugged innocently.
"I never said I did.
I never said I didn’t."
Mira clicked her tongue and rolled her eyes, returning to her meal.
Dexter smiled as he turned to Selene and Lyra.
But Lyra had resumed eating while Selene was staring at Mira with her white eyes.

In under ten seconds, he had pulled a clean shirt over his wife-beater singlet, grabbed his shoes, and was at the front door.

chapters.title: Chapter 127 | Monster Outbreak
paragraphs: Dexter was completely unaware of the drama back at home.
He was behind the wheel of his Vanguard V4, weaving through morning traffic at dangerous speeds.
He couldn’t use the Type-6 Aegis Skybreaker as it was still daytime, and pulling a combat-grade flying SUV out of thin air in broad daylight would raise too many questions.
So the ordinary-looking armored SUV would have to do.

The GPS on his phone displayed the pinned location. He was already two minutes behind schedule thanks to the argument at the breakfast table. The Vanguard V4’s engine roared as he floored the accelerator.
In under four minutes, he crossed into the next district.
The moment he arrived, chaos greeted him.
The street was in pandemonium.
The bustling market district had become a living nightmare.
People ran through the streets with faces twisted in absolute terror, their desperate screams echoing from every direction.
"Run!"
"It’s coming!"
"Help! Somebody help!"
Children cried as parents dragged them through the streets. Some stumbled and fell, only to be yanked back to their feet before the stampede swallowed them.

Cars had collided with one another in desperate attempts to escape. Twisted metal blocked entire intersections as horns blared endlessly, some vehicles still idling with their doors hanging wide open.
It was obvious their owners had abandoned them in blind panic.
A truck slammed into a traffic light with a deafening crash.
Glass exploded across the road.
Another vehicle flipped onto its side after swerving to avoid something charging through the smoke.
"BOOM!"
An explosion erupted somewhere down the street.
The shockwave rattled nearby buildings as black smoke billowed into the morning sky.
The air was a symphony of horror.
Screams.
Gunfire.
Crunching metal.
Shattering glass.
And above it all...
Deep, loud roars that no normal creature on earth should have been capable of producing.
The monstrous cries reverberated through the district, making even the bravest civilians freeze in fear before instinct forced them to run once more.
Dexter parked the Vanguard V4 and stepped out.
The moment his boots touched the pavement, recognition flashed through his eyes.
This was the market district.
The very place where he had bought groceries and supplies during his first week after moving into the bungalow.
Only days ago it had been lively and crowded.
Now, It looked like a battlefield.
Storefronts had been ripped open as though struck by a missile.
Market stalls had been reduced to splintered wood scattered across the streets.
Fresh vegetables and fruits lay crushed beneath countless footprints, their juices mixing with shattered glass, spent shell casings, and pools of fresh blood.
A delivery truck had crashed straight through the front of a pharmacy, its engine still sputtering while flames sparked beneath the hood of the vehicle.
At the daw end of a store, a woman knelt beside a motionless man, desperately shaking his shoulders while sobbing uncontrollably.
"Husband, wake up... please... please wake up..."
"Ahhhhh!!!"
Nearby, another civilian was dragged screaming into an alley.
His cries lasted only a few seconds before ending in a sickening crunch.
There was silence, then a wet tearing sound reverberated.
The people who witnessed it screamed even louder and fled in every direction.
At the center of the devastation, reality itself had been torn apart.
A massive dimensional gate floated several meters above the ground, crackling with unstable energy.
The space around it distorted continuously, as if the world itself were struggling to heal the wound.

And from that rip in reality, monsters surged in like a swarm, leaping and clawing their way out of the gate as they shoved and climbs over one another in their eagerness to reach the fleeing civilians.
The creatures roared with savage excitement the instant they caught sight of prey.
Dexter’s eyes narrowed.
"Fiend-Class monsters..."
He recognized them immediately.
Four-Armed Goblins.
A far deadlier evolution of ordinary goblins.
Unlike their smaller cousins, these creatures stood as tall as fully grown adults, with several towering well over two meters.
Their sickly green-gray skin stretched over powerful, corded muscles that rippled with frightening strength.
Elongated snouts jutted forward, lined with rows of jagged yellow fangs slick with saliva.
Small bloodshot eyes burned with animalistic hunger.
Long, pointed ears twitched constantly as they searched for the next terrified victim.
Some possessed only two muscular arms.
Others had four.
The greater the number of arms, the stronger the goblin.
The Four-Arm goblins have two massive arms protruding normally from their shoulders, while another pair sprouted from behind their shoulder blades, giving them a grotesque, spider-like silhouette.
Each arm moved independently.
One could wield crude weapons while the others clawed, grabbed, or tore apart anything within reach.
Against ordinary civilians, they were living, breathing nightmares.
Dexter assessed their strength.
’Level 3 to Level 12.’
And they are all Fiend Class. Most F-rank heroes, would be cautious and wait for back up.
But Dexter wasn’t most people.
At that split second, a car swerved wildly, trying to bypass a goblin.
The creature’s four arms swung simultaneously, catching the vehicle’s side panel.
"Bang!"
The car spun sideways as it slammed into a building nearby.
The driver crawled out, bleeding from the head, as he stumbled away on foot, panicking.
Not far from him, a young couple were running together, as they fled from a four-armed goblin chasing after them.
The Four-arm Goblin chased after them. It’s speed fast as its mouth stretched wide in a horrifying grin.
The man’s expression changed. Them all of a sudden, he grabbed the woman by the side and shoved her backwards.
The woman was stunned and she stumbled backward by the force, falling tk the ground as her head hit a nearby car.
"S-Simon!? What are you doing!? Help me!!!"
She wasn’t Valentin finish her sentence when the goblin descended on her.
The boyfriend didn’t look back but ran faster.
Although it took a while to explain m, everything happened in a split second.
With Dexter’s hearing, he could map out everything in a 300 meter radius and it would be visible to him as though he was there, rendering a 3d image of the surroundings to him.
Dexter raised an eyebrow. A flicker of disgust crossed his face, but he didn’t waste time judging. He was already moving.
[Flame Burst Step]
