chapters.title: Chapter 128 | Monster Outbreak 2
paragraphs: "Flame Burst Step!"
The world blurred as heat exploded beneath his feet.

His body rocketed forward, crossing thirty meters in a fraction of a second as he materialized beside the four-armed goblin just as its jaws unhinged and its mouth opened wide enough to swallow the young woman’s entire head.
The Macro Splicing Saber appeared in his hands as he called it out from the storage ring.
"Squelch!"
Dexter easily drove the blade through the back of the goblin’s skull.
The black steel tore through its skull and its brain before erupting from the creature’s open mouth in a shower of thick, green blood pouring down on the woman’s face, nose and mouth.
The goblin’s body stiffened, and it instantly went limp as it collapsed forward, crashing to the ground inches from the young woman’s body.
As the green blood splattered across the woman’s body, she shrieked even more as though the stain was worse than death!
"AAAAAAHHH!" "AAAAAHHH!"
"Shut up," Dexter growled, his voice cutting through her panic like a blade. "Find a safe place and hide. Now."
The woman’s mouth snapped shut. She opened her eyes through the green gore on her face and saw Dexter standing above her.
She sniffed hard as tears streamed down her face. She quickly scrambled to her feet. "Th-thank you," she stuttered, her body shaking violently. "Thank you, I—"
Dexter immediately ignored her as he activated Flame Burst Step, blasting towards the nearby Goblin.
[Slaughter Extraction System: Kill Count — 1/51]
The notification registered in the back of his mind, but Dexter barely noticed. He was already moving.
He had noticed something different when he activated the bloodline technique.
It was easier to use, and he felt like he could use it way longer than he used to.

Instead of a 500% speed increase for two seconds, he could actually control and sustain the blast of energy beneath his feet to not just be a single violent explosion but a steady stream of explosions.
His body blurred forward as his head blasted behind him, and this time, the bloodline skill didn’t cancel after five seconds.
With his upgraded bloodline, he felt like he could sustain it for nearly a minute before his body began to show strain. And if he pushed himself, he could probably extend it further.
’This is new,’he thought, a grim smile touching his lips as he rocketed toward his next target.
The second goblin was attacking a man inside his store.
"Graaa!"
The goblin growled as it cornered the store owner behind its own counter, its four arms reaching over the top, clawing at the man who was desperately trying to hold it back with a baseball bat.
Dexter’s eyes locked onto the shopkeeper’s face and he immediately recognized him.
The shopkeeper was the same man who had sold him groceries during his first week at the bungalow.
The same man who had doubled the price of pork just because he heard a rumor on the internet.
Dexter’s gaze turned dark, and he smirked. ’
’Let him suffer a bit.’
Dexter turned away and moved to save someone else.
As he turned around, the goblin smashed the counter, grabbed the man before tossing him across his own store like a rag doll.
"Bang!"
The man crashed into a wall, slid down, and tried to crawl away.
"Help! Help! Somebody help me!!!"
He tried to fight back, but the hiblkn sneered as it smacked him sideways into a rack of canned goods.
Cans exploded in all directions. The trader spat blood as his face bled with blood and pure terror.
At this moment, Dexter appeared before another Goblin.
It was a level 10 Goblin, and it had gripped the neck of a woman tightly, squeezing the life out of her as it watched with relish.
"Whoosh!"
The air shook as the goblin quickly reacted and punched at the space beside it.
"Bang!"
Shockwaves exploded in a circular pattern as the Dexter caught the punch with his palm.
"Whoosh!"
A dark light glinted and blood splattered in the air as Dexter’s blade easily sliced a long blood line through the Monster’s skull.
"Cough! Cough!"
The woman dropped to the ground with a flushed face as she wanted to thank Dexter, but he was long gone.
Dexter’s speed was so fast he appeared behind another Goblin.
"Roooar!"
The goblin was roaring and angry as it clawed at a locked car door.
His Type-3 blade easily cut through its skin without hesitation.
At this moment, the trader’s screams had turned faint as though he had given up.
Dexter sighed.
’Fine.’
He activated Flame Burst Step and closed the distance in an instant.

The Macro Splicing Saber swept upward in a clean, horizontal arc. The goblin’s head separated from its shoulders with surgical precision, the creature’s four arms still reaching for the shopkeeper as its body crumpled to the floor.
Green blood fountained from the severed neck, splattering the shelves of canned goods behind it.
The shopkeeper screamed as he scrambled on the ground. He looked up through the gore and debris, and saw Dexter standing over the goblin’s twitching corpse.
"D-Dexter?" the man stammered, his face pale with shock. "You’re—you’re the—"
Dexter glared at the trader indifferently as he turned to leave.
[Slaughter Extraction System: Kill Count — 4/51]
[Extracted: +2 Strength, +1 Agility]
"W-who’s going to pay for the damages?"
Dexter wanted to turn back and choke the man to death but he inhaled deeply and blurred out of the man’s store.
Flames erupted behind him as it burnt a few nearby items.
"Hey! What the hell!?"
The trader shouted after Dexter.
A few goblins actually carried crude weapons like clubs, sharpened bones or stone spears.
Dexter was like a grinding machine; he easily cut through them like a scythe through wheat.
As he drew nearer to the center of the district, his ears flickered as he heard the sounds of two children crying.
He changed direction immediately, his body cutting through the chaos like a missile as he saw two kids standing in the middle of the road.
They were quite young. The older one was perhaps 9 years old and the younger one, no more than 3 years old.
The 9-year-old had his arms wrapped tightly around his toddler brother, as they crouched in the middle of the wrecked street.
"Mom!" "Mom!"
The sound of their crying carried through the market district. And it immediately attracted attention.
A massive goblin emerged from the smoke as it shot towards them like a missile.
’Level 12 Fiend Class Monster!’

sentences.text: "Flame Burst Step!"
The world blurred as heat exploded beneath his feet.

His body rocketed forward, crossing thirty meters in a fraction of a second as he materialized beside the four-armed goblin just as its jaws unhinged and its mouth opened wide enough to swallow the young woman’s entire head.
The Macro Splicing Saber appeared in his hands as he called it out from the storage ring.
"Squelch!"
Dexter easily drove the blade through the back of the goblin’s skull.
The black steel tore through its skull and its brain before erupting from the creature’s open mouth in a shower of thick, green blood pouring down on the woman’s face, nose and mouth.
The goblin’s body stiffened, and it instantly went limp as it collapsed forward, crashing to the ground inches from the young woman’s body.
As the green blood splattered across the woman’s body, she shrieked even more as though the stain was worse than death!
"AAAAAAHHH!" "AAAAAHHH!"
"Shut up," Dexter growled, his voice cutting through her panic like a blade.
"Find a safe place and hide.
Now."
The woman’s mouth snapped shut.
She opened her eyes through the green gore on her face and saw Dexter standing above her.
She sniffed hard as tears streamed down her face.
She quickly scrambled to her feet.
"Th-thank you," she stuttered, her body shaking violently.
"Thank you, I—"
Dexter immediately ignored her as he activated Flame Burst Step, blasting towards the nearby Goblin.
[Slaughter Extraction System: Kill Count — 1/51]
The notification registered in the back of his mind, but Dexter barely noticed.
He was already moving.
He had noticed something different when he activated the bloodline technique.
It was easier to use, and he felt like he could use it way longer than he used to.

Instead of a 500% speed increase for two seconds, he could actually control and sustain the blast of energy beneath his feet to not just be a single violent explosion but a steady stream of explosions.
His body blurred forward as his head blasted behind him, and this time, the bloodline skill didn’t cancel after five seconds.
With his upgraded bloodline, he felt like he could sustain it for nearly a minute before his body began to show strain.
And if he pushed himself, he could probably extend it further.
’This is new,’he thought, a grim smile touching his lips as he rocketed toward his next target.
The second goblin was attacking a man inside his store.
"Graaa!"
The goblin growled as it cornered the store owner behind its own counter, its four arms reaching over the top, clawing at the man who was desperately trying to hold it back with a baseball bat.
Dexter’s eyes locked onto the shopkeeper’s face and he immediately recognized him.
The shopkeeper was the same man who had sold him groceries during his first week at the bungalow.
The same man who had doubled the price of pork just because he heard a rumor on the internet.
Dexter’s gaze turned dark, and he smirked. ’
’Let him suffer a bit.’
Dexter turned away and moved to save someone else.
As he turned around, the goblin smashed the counter, grabbed the man before tossing him across his own store like a rag doll.
"Bang!"
The man crashed into a wall, slid down, and tried to crawl away.
"Help!
Help!
Somebody help me!!!"
He tried to fight back, but the hiblkn sneered as it smacked him sideways into a rack of canned goods.
Cans exploded in all directions.
The trader spat blood as his face bled with blood and pure terror.
At this moment, Dexter appeared before another Goblin.
It was a level 10 Goblin, and it had gripped the neck of a woman tightly, squeezing the life out of her as it watched with relish.
"Whoosh!"
The air shook as the goblin quickly reacted and punched at the space beside it.
"Bang!"
Shockwaves exploded in a circular pattern as the Dexter caught the punch with his palm.
"Whoosh!"
A dark light glinted and blood splattered in the air as Dexter’s blade easily sliced a long blood line through the Monster’s skull.
"Cough!
Cough!"
The woman dropped to the ground with a flushed face as she wanted to thank Dexter, but he was long gone.
Dexter’s speed was so fast he appeared behind another Goblin.
"Roooar!"
The goblin was roaring and angry as it clawed at a locked car door.
His Type-3 blade easily cut through its skin without hesitation.
At this moment, the trader’s screams had turned faint as though he had given up.
Dexter sighed.
’Fine.’
He activated Flame Burst Step and closed the distance in an instant.
The Macro Splicing Saber swept upward in a clean, horizontal arc.
The goblin’s head separated from its shoulders with surgical precision, the creature’s four arms still reaching for the shopkeeper as its body crumpled to the floor.
Green blood fountained from the severed neck, splattering the shelves of canned goods behind it.
The shopkeeper screamed as he scrambled on the ground.
He looked up through the gore and debris, and saw Dexter standing over the goblin’s twitching corpse.
"D-Dexter?" the man stammered, his face pale with shock.
"You’re—you’re the—"
Dexter glared at the trader indifferently as he turned to leave.
[Slaughter Extraction System: Kill Count — 4/51]
[Extracted: +2 Strength, +1 Agility]
"W-who’s going to pay for the damages?"
Dexter wanted to turn back and choke the man to death but he inhaled deeply and blurred out of the man’s store.
Flames erupted behind him as it burnt a few nearby items.
"Hey!
What the hell!?"
The trader shouted after Dexter.
A few goblins actually carried crude weapons like clubs, sharpened bones or stone spears.
Dexter was like a grinding machine; he easily cut through them like a scythe through wheat.
As he drew nearer to the center of the district, his ears flickered as he heard the sounds of two children crying.
He changed direction immediately, his body cutting through the chaos like a missile as he saw two kids standing in the middle of the road.
They were quite young.
The older one was perhaps 9 years old and the younger one, no more than 3 years old.
The 9-year-old had his arms wrapped tightly around his toddler brother, as they crouched in the middle of the wrecked street.
"Mom!" "Mom!"
The sound of their crying carried through the market district.
And it immediately attracted attention.
A massive goblin emerged from the smoke as it shot towards them like a missile.
’Level 12 Fiend Class Monster!’

chapters.title: Chapter 129 | Cold Hearted Hero
paragraphs: Dexter’s face changed.
"Level 12, Fiend Class Monster."
Six levels higher than Dexter.
This particular Goblin was different. It was much bigger than the others as it stood nearly two meters tall with a large crude hammer in its massive arm.
And its eyes weren’t particularly bloodshot like the rest, but it had a tinge of intelligence in them.
The goblin’s nostrils flared as it caught the children’s scent. The moment its eyes landed on them, its mouth stretched into a grin as thick saliva dripped from its jaws.
It stepped forward and appeared half a meter away from them as it stretched three of its four arms at the kids.
One of its hands stroked the kid’s hair as if fascinated by the brown hair of the kid.
Its mouth watered, and the drool in its mouth increased. It had never had such fresh and tender meat before.
Before the invasion, the commander promised so much meat that they could never finish, but he didn’t expect to see such premium and fresh meat. Not to mention, there were two of them.
The older kid seemed to have felt the arm on its head, and it looked back.
"Waaaaaaah!"
The kid screamed, which caused the goblin to scream more as its mouth slowly spread open.
The air shimmered with heat as a dark saber flashed through the air in a large arc.
"Whoosh!"
The blade caught the goblin’s lower-right arm at the elbow, severing it cleanly as green blood sprayed in a wide arc.
However, it was able to react quickly, saving its three other arms from being severed.
"ROOOOOOAR!"
The goblin roared in pain as its severed arm flew in mid-air. The sound was so loud that the glass windows of the nearby vehicle and shops vibrated.
That was because, along with the roar, it had also activated its crowd control skill without hesitation.
It was so deep and powerful that the windows of nearby cars vibrated. But the roar wasn’t just sound. It was a technique.
[Intimidating Roar]
The sonic roar hit Dexter’s brain like a sledgehammer.
With his enhanced senses, he received more than double the effect!
The entire world blurred as his vision spun.
His thoughts scattered like leaves in a hurricane as an invisible, crushing pressure invaded his consciousness, trying to stun him.
"Bang!"
The Abyssal Emperor Flame erupted within his body as the violet fire blazed through his meridians, his blood, his very soul.
The divine-demonic flame didn’t just resist the mental intrusion; it incinerated it.
The two children weren’t as fortunate. The roar’s mental attack overwhelmed their young minds instantly as they collapsed to the ground.
Although Dexter managed to recover, he had been stunned for 0.2 seconds.
In this world, 0.2 seconds was more than enough time for one to die three times over.
"Graaaa!"
The goblin growled as it swung its hammer in a wide arc, slamming it directly against Dexter’s skull.
"Whoosh!"
Dexter managed to shift his head to the side as the hammer slammed directly to his shoulder.
"BOOM!"
A massive shockwave erupted from the point of impact as it radiated through the air like stone dropped into still water.
Every car within ten meters had its windows explode simultaneously as glass fragments showered the street like rain.
The pavement beneath Dexter’s feet instantly shattered as his body transmitted the force directly to the ground.
This was one of the benefits of Iron Body Stage, transmitting force easily without damaging the body!

Any normal level 7 Superhuman hero’s body would have shattered immediately, but Dexter was not just cultivating a 7th Tier body technique; the Slaughter Extraction System also extracts attributes from dead monsters, strengthening his body to a terrifying level!
Dexter’s brows furrowed slightly. "That hurts."
The goblin’s eyes widened in panic, and it punched out with another fist.
"Bang!"
Dexter caught the fist with his left hand.
"My turn."
"Bang!"
He instantly kicked out, and the entire body of the Goblin was sent flying like a bullet as it collided against the wall of a building.
It wasn’t even able to recover when Dexter appeared before it.
The Macro Splicing Saber swept upward in a single, devastating arc.
"Whoosh!"
The goblin tried to block it with its hammer, but it was too slow.
The saber swept upwards as it cleanly passed through the goblin’s body.
The goblin stood frozen there in disbelief.
Then a thin, crimson line appeared at the center of its body. The line spread slowly at first, then rapidly until it divided the goblin into two perfect halves.
The two pieces fell apart in opposite directions, hitting the ground with twin wet thuds.
[Kill Count — 17/51]
[Extracted: +5 Strength, +4 Agility, +3 Physique, +2 Mana]
Dexter didn’t pause to admire his work. He sheathed his blade, scooped both unconscious children from the ground, activated Flame Burst Step, and carried them to the nearest intact storefront.
He kicked the door open, gently laid them on the floor behind the counter, and checked their pulses.
Stable but unconscious, and they were breathing normally. The Intimidating Roar’s effect would wear off soon.
He stepped back outside and launched himself back into the chaos.
Dexter moved through the market like a rotor blade, his Flame Burst Step easily carrying him with bursts of speed as his blade slashed through one goblin after the other.
His kill count climbed steadily.
[Kill Count — 21/51]
[Kill Count — 22/51]
[Kill Count — 23/51]
Then, at the far end of the main street, he spotted another hero.
The hero was a tall man with broad shoulders. From his energy wave, he was a level 12 superhuman. He wielded a spear that crackled with blue mana.
Dexter immediately recognized the hero from TV as Bullet Spear.
A popular neighborhood E-rank hero loved by the masses and popular amongst the children for his fast spear attacks.
He is said to have cleared multiple F-rank dungeons and responded to multiple monster outbreaks, saving countless lives in the process.
Currently, Bullet Spear moved through the goblin ranks as he pierced through them with his spear, moving like a bullet.
Each strike found a vital point—throat, heart, spine. Goblins fell before him in rapid succession.
By Dexter’s estimate, his killing speed was impressively faster than Dexter’s simply because he wasn’t stopping to rescue civilians!
And that was the problem.
Unlike his hero title, Bullet Spear wasn’t saving anyone, he was using the civilians as bait to clear monsters and upgrade his rank!
Dexter coldly watched from fifty meters away as the spear-wielding hero engaged a group of four-armed goblins.
The creatures had been attacking a cluster of trapped civilians huddled inside an overturned bus.
Instead of drawing the goblins away from the civilians, Bullet Spear waited until the goblins were fully focused on their prey, killing them.
With their backs turned, it was then he struck, killing them from behind while they were distracted.
It was effective and efficient but incredibly cold-hearted.
Dexter found himself grudgingly impressed by the idea. But shook his head.
Bullet Spear was treating the outbreak like a hunting ground, and the civilians were nothing more than bait to lure his targets into vulnerable positions.
Dexter shook his head and continued his kills.
At that time, more heroes began to arrive with vehicles. One after the other. It was obvious that they too had received the alert.
Small groups of E-rank and F-rank heroes rushed in rapidly to help kill monsters and save civilians.
They fanned out through the district, engaging goblins and evacuating civilians.
It was at that moment that the sky suddenly changed.

chapters.title: Chapter 130 | The Goblin King
paragraphs: Then the sky changed.
"Rumble!"
The clouds parted with a resonant boom, and a figure descended from above, dropping through the atmosphere like a meteor, trailing streams of compressed air and crackling electrical energy.
"Boom!"
The figure landed at the center of the market square sending out a shockwave of wind and dust rippling outward. Every goblin within fifty meters was knocked off its feet.
Dexter shielded his eyes from the dust cloud and when it cleared, a woman stood at the center of the impact crater.

Long silver hair flowed behind her like a river of moonlight. A black combat coat with silver trim clung to her frame, moving in the wind like living shadow. On her chest, gleaming in the morning light, was an S-rank badge.
She was the woman he had seen at the Hero Association entrance. The one Rachel had pointed out. The rising star who had recently been promoted to S-rank after clearing her first S-rank dungeon.
Aurora.
The one with the sky manipulation talent.
Her gaze swept across the market as she observed everything going on.
Suddenly, she glanced upwards .
"Boom!"
She raised one hand and the space itself twisted.
A four-armed goblin that had been climbing a building nearby suddenly found the air around it warping.
The air compressed and slapped the wrapped around the creature’s body, sending it flying through the air directly toward Aurora.
The S-rank hero didn’t even blink. She extended her palm as the goblin’s body arrived, gently pressing her hand against its back.
"Crumble!"
The creature disintegrated.

The goblin’s body shattered into multiple pieces—arms, legs, torso, head—all separating cleanly as if the creature had been made of glass struck by a hammer. The fragments fell to the ground in a shower of green blood and ruptured organs, pooling beneath Aurora’s boots.
Dexter who had just killed a beast and saw this had a change of expression.
’That talent...’
If she pressed that palm against his body . Dexter wasn’t certain his body could withstand it.
He shook his head and resumed his killing.

Across the district, the spear-wielding hero Bullet Spear Hero continued his own killing spree. His kill count was impressive, easily matching Dexter. But unlike Dexter, he still hadn’t directly saved a single civilian.
But Aurora was on another level entirely.
The S-rank hero moved through the battlefield like a ghost, her silver hair trailing behind her like a banner. Every goblin she approached died eith a simple touch.
Her kill count was the highest by far. In the time Dexter had killed thirty, she had dispatched over forty. The goblins didn’t even slow her down.

In under three minutes, the heroes had turned the tide. Most of the civilians in the market district had been evacuated to safe zones, and the streets were now littered with the corpses of two-armed and four-armed goblins.
The heroes excitedly killed more of the beasts as adrenaline fueled them.
They were so focused on their killing sprreeband raising their ranks that none of them noticed the dimensional gate begin to violently ripple again.
A massive hand, reached out, grabbed the edges of the torn space and pulled it apart as it walked out.
A Six-Armed Goblin King. The dungeon boss had emerged.
There were two ways to resolve a dungeon outbreak. The first was to use a space stabilizer to temporarily seal the dimensional gate.
This was the easiest and most common method, as it immediately stopped the flow of monsters, but it didn’t guarantee the same gate wouldn’t reopen in the future.
The second, and permanent, method was to kill the dungeon boss. Once the boss was slain, the dungeon core was destroyed, ensuring it would never appear again.
But a boss of this caliber wasn’t something a group of low-ranking heroes could simply gang up on.
And the King was not alone.
Four massive, four-armed goblins stepped out behind the boss. These were elite Goblin commander, each radiating a terrifying, suffocating aura.
A Mutated Class monster equaled a Meta Hero. A Fiend Class equaled a Super Hero. And an Ultra Class equaled an Ultra Hero.
The four commanders were Ultra Class monsters, ranked at Levels One, Two, Three, and Four respectively.
But the boss, the Six-Armed Goblin King—was a Level Seven Ultra Class monster.
They appeared silently, observing the distracted heroes with predatory amusement.
Without warning, the Level Four commander blurred into motion as it appeared behind a celebrating hero who was busy finishing off a Level 5 Fiend Class goblin.
"Squelch!"
The commander swept stabbed its crude sword into the hero’s neck.
"W-what?"
The hero ea stunned as she felt a cold sensation in her neck as her spine severed and a blade lashed through her neck.
Before the body could even hit the ground, the commander opened its massive jaws and bit half of the female hero’s head.
The skull popped like a grape. The monster chewed loudly, grinning happily as blood and brain matter oozed down its chin.
"Be careful!" someone seem to have noticed this and screamed in terror frim across the street.
The heroes’ expressions changed as they looked around.
But it was too late. The commanders had already spread out, charging into the crowd of heroes with devastating force.
The Goblin King’s burning crimson eyes swept the battlefield, instantly locking onto the most dangerous presence: Aurora.
Space twisted as it simply folded the distance, appearing directly behind the silver-haired S-rank hero.
Its massive, armored fist swung downward toward her massive chest.
Before the blow could land—
"BOOM!!!"

A massive explosion rang out a sa massive force slapped the Goblin King mid attack, sending it skidding sideways, its massive feet digging trenches into the asphalt as though the road were made of soft sand.
Aurora turned as she looked at her side.
Beside her was Dexter. He head the one who attacked and intercepted the Goblin King midway.
Aurora’s face was cold and indifferent as she glanced at him as though looking at an ant. "I didn’t need your help."
Dexter didn’t even look at her.
He glanced toward a battered taxi sitting just behind where Aurora had been standing.
Without waiting for her response, he flashed over to the taxi. Using his enhanced hearing, he had heard the heartbeat of someone hiding beneath the dashboard.
If the Goblin King’s strike had connected with Aurora, the resulting shockwave of their clash would have instantly pulverized the old man inside the vehicle.
That was why Dexter had intercepted the blow.
He ripped the dented car door off its hinges, gently pulled the trembling old man out, and activated Flame Burst Step.
In a blur of crimson fire, he carried the civilian out of the warzone, depositing him safely in an alley three blocks away.
The old man quickly thanked him."Thank you, hero. Thank you."
Dexter merely nodded, turned, and launched himself back toward the market district.
At this moment, the four commander beasts were tearing through the heroes. The difference between the Superhuman Realm and the Ultra Realm was as vast as the distance between the earth and the sky.
While every level breakthrough in the Superhuman Realm granted a fifty-point increase to each attribute, the Ultra Realm granted a staggering one hundred and fifty points to each attribute per level.
But it wasn’t just numbers. There was a fundamental, qualitative shift in the body at the Ultra Realm. As one edged into the transcendent realm, they began to become one with the world.
Their mana changed at a molecular level, gaining the terrifying ability to condense from pure energy into solid, physical matter!
A Level Four Ultra Goblin commander grabbed a fleeing civilian. It drove its clawed hand directly into the man’s belly.
The man screamed, a sound of pure, unadulterated agony, as the beast’s arm plunged through his abdomen. With a violent yank, the commander ripped the man’s spine entirely out through his stomach.
The civilian didn’t die instantly.
He hung in the air, held up by the beast’s grip, screaming as his spine which was still dripping with blood and gore was waved in the air like a trophy.

But Aurora was on another level entirely.
The S-rank hero moved through the battlefield like a ghost, her silver hair trailing behind her like a banner.
Every goblin she approached died eith a simple touch.
Her kill count was the highest by far.
In the time Dexter had killed thirty, she had dispatched over forty.
The goblins didn’t even slow her down.
In under three minutes, the heroes had turned the tide.
Most of the civilians in the market district had been evacuated to safe zones, and the streets were now littered with the corpses of two-armed and four-armed goblins.
The heroes excitedly killed more of the beasts as adrenaline fueled them.
They were so focused on their killing sprreeband raising their ranks that none of them noticed the dimensional gate begin to violently ripple again.
A massive hand, reached out, grabbed the edges of the torn space and pulled it apart as it walked out.
A Six-Armed Goblin King.
The dungeon boss had emerged.
There were two ways to resolve a dungeon outbreak.
The first was to use a space stabilizer to temporarily seal the dimensional gate.
This was the easiest and most common method, as it immediately stopped the flow of monsters, but it didn’t guarantee the same gate wouldn’t reopen in the future.
The second, and permanent, method was to kill the dungeon boss.
Once the boss was slain, the dungeon core was destroyed, ensuring it would never appear again.
But a boss of this caliber wasn’t something a group of low-ranking heroes could simply gang up on.
And the King was not alone.
Four massive, four-armed goblins stepped out behind the boss.
These were elite Goblin commander, each radiating a terrifying, suffocating aura.
A Mutated Class monster equaled a Meta Hero.
A Fiend Class equaled a Super Hero.
And an Ultra Class equaled an Ultra Hero.
The four commanders were Ultra Class monsters, ranked at Levels One, Two, Three, and Four respectively.
But the boss, the Six-Armed Goblin King—was a Level Seven Ultra Class monster.
They appeared silently, observing the distracted heroes with predatory amusement.
Without warning, the Level Four commander blurred into motion as it appeared behind a celebrating hero who was busy finishing off a Level 5 Fiend Class goblin.
"Squelch!"
The commander swept stabbed its crude sword into the hero’s neck.
"W-what?"
The hero ea stunned as she felt a cold sensation in her neck as her spine severed and a blade lashed through her neck.
Before the body could even hit the ground, the commander opened its massive jaws and bit half of the female hero’s head.
The skull popped like a grape.
The monster chewed loudly, grinning happily as blood and brain matter oozed down its chin.
"Be careful!" someone seem to have noticed this and screamed in terror frim across the street.
The heroes’ expressions changed as they looked around.
But it was too late.
The commanders had already spread out, charging into the crowd of heroes with devastating force.
The Goblin King’s burning crimson eyes swept the battlefield, instantly locking onto the most dangerous presence: Aurora.
Space twisted as it simply folded the distance, appearing directly behind the silver-haired S-rank hero.
Its massive, armored fist swung downward toward her massive chest.
Before the blow could land—
"BOOM!!!"

A massive explosion rang out a sa massive force slapped the Goblin King mid attack, sending it skidding sideways, its massive feet digging trenches into the asphalt as though the road were made of soft sand.
Aurora turned as she looked at her side.
Beside her was Dexter.
He head the one who attacked and intercepted the Goblin King midway.
Aurora’s face was cold and indifferent as she glanced at him as though looking at an ant.
"I didn’t need your help."
Dexter didn’t even look at her.
He glanced toward a battered taxi sitting just behind where Aurora had been standing.
Without waiting for her response, he flashed over to the taxi.
Using his enhanced hearing, he had heard the heartbeat of someone hiding beneath the dashboard.
If the Goblin King’s strike had connected with Aurora, the resulting shockwave of their clash would have instantly pulverized the old man inside the vehicle.
That was why Dexter had intercepted the blow.
He ripped the dented car door off its hinges, gently pulled the trembling old man out, and activated Flame Burst Step.
In a blur of crimson fire, he carried the civilian out of the warzone, depositing him safely in an alley three blocks away.
The old man quickly thanked him."Thank you, hero.
Thank you."
Dexter merely nodded, turned, and launched himself back toward the market district.
At this moment, the four commander beasts were tearing through the heroes.
The difference between the Superhuman Realm and the Ultra Realm was as vast as the distance between the earth and the sky.
While every level breakthrough in the Superhuman Realm granted a fifty-point increase to each attribute, the Ultra Realm granted a staggering one hundred and fifty points to each attribute per level.
But it wasn’t just numbers.
There was a fundamental, qualitative shift in the body at the Ultra Realm.
As one edged into the transcendent realm, they began to become one with the world.
Their mana changed at a molecular level, gaining the terrifying ability to condense from pure energy into solid, physical matter!
A Level Four Ultra Goblin commander grabbed a fleeing civilian.
It drove its clawed hand directly into the man’s belly.
The man screamed, a sound of pure, unadulterated agony, as the beast’s arm plunged through his abdomen.
With a violent yank, the commander ripped the man’s spine entirely out through his stomach.
The civilian didn’t die instantly.
He hung in the air, held up by the beast’s grip, screaming as his spine which was still dripping with blood and gore was waved in the air like a trophy.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 | Facing An Ultra Class Beast!
paragraphs: As the Goblin King and its commanders unleashed their aura, the surrounding heroes’ faces changed when they realized they were facing Ultra Level monsters.
"This is clearly not a E rank Gate!"
One of them said through clenched his teeth. Most of the heroes present were only in the Superhuman Realm.
Aurora’s cold voice echoed through the ears of every hero nearby, cutting through the panic.
"I will stop the Level 7 Ultra-level boss. The rest of you, find a way to stop the other four commanders."
She didn’t wait for acknowledgment. Aurora vanished, moving so fast she created a sonic boom that shattered the remaining glass in the district.
"BOOM!"
She collided with the Six-Armed Goblin King, and the resulting impact blasted both of them directly into a massive shopping mall.
Deafening booms echoed from within the building, sounding like the beating of a massive war drum as the two Ultra powers clashed.
Left with no other choice, the remaining heroes divided into groups to confront the four commander beasts. Their only hope was to gang up on them.
Just as the Bullet Spear Man was contemplating whether he should even attempt to fight an Ultra-level beast, a figure plummeted from a tall building nearby.
"Bang!"
His hero name was Kinetic Man, a popular C-rank hero, but more importantly, a Level One Ultra Realm expert.
He turned to the Bullet Spear Man. "Let’s deal with this one," he said, pointing at the Level Four Four-Armed Goblin Commander.
Then he turned to the others. "You guys handle the other three."
The Bullet Spear Man’s face tightened, but he had no choice but to nod. He and Kinetic Man charged forward to engage the Level Four beast.
The rest of the heroes quickly split up. Five heroes went to face the Level Three commander. Four heroes engaged the Level Two, and another three rushed the Level One.
Dexter had just returned from dropping off the old man. He surveyed the battlefield instantly.
He saw the five heroes facing the Level Three beast. They had absolutely no chance. Even with a numerical advantage, the power gap was too immense.

On the other side, Kinetic Man was faring better. Using his kinetic talent and his shield, he was able to absorb the kinetic energy from the Level Four beast’s strikes, effectively tanking the attacks.

Meanwhile, the Bullet Spear Man used his incredible speed and piercing spear strikes to chip away at the beast. Dexter had heard of Kinetic Man; his ability to absorb and release kinetic energy made him the perfect shield. They would be alright.
But the five heroes fighting the Level Three commander were being slaughtered.
A simple punch from the beast sent one hero flying through a wall. A stomp nearly crushed another, but a third hero with a speed talent managed to push his comrade out of the way just in time.
They were barely containing it, saving each other from fatal blows, but they were taking heavy damage. Blood dripped from the corners of their mouths, and their movements were growing sluggish.
Dexter immediately sprinted toward them.
As he closed the distance, the Level Three goblin commander reached out with one of its massive hands and grabbed one of the heroes by the neck.
It lifted the man off the ground. The hero screamed, frantically punching the beast’s thick, armored arm, but it was like hitting a mountain.
The other heroes lunged forward to save him, but the goblin’s remaining three arms moved, perfectly blocking their attacks effortlessly.
"Graaaa!"
The beast’s grip tightened and was about to snap the hero’s neck like a twig.
Dexter’s eyes flared with violet light.
"Flame Burst Step!"
He crossed the remaining distance in a blink, leaving a trail of scorched air behind him as he materialized directly in front of the Level Three Ultra beast.
"Flame Slash!"
Dexter activated the bloodline skill without hesitation, his saber erupting in a crescent of compressed violet fire as he swung it directly at the four-armed goblin’s neck.
"CLANG!"
A green dome barrier materialized instantly around the beast, erupting from its skin like a translucent tortoise shell.
Space warped around the point of impact, as shockwaves rippled outward, cracking the asphalt beneath their feet.
The beast unconsciously released its grip on the hero and the man dropped to the ground, gasping and clutching his throat in horror.
The speedster hero quickly grabbed his comrade by the arm and dragging him away from the beast’s reach.
"Hold it for thirty more seconds!" a voice roared from behind.
Dexter glanced sideways. A hero in a red and white suit, had his entire body crackling with blinding blue plasma energy.
His hero name was Plasmatic.
Dexter frowned slightly but he eventually nodded his head.
The space around him shifted as his speed exploded. He vanished from in front of the beast and reappeared behind it.
The beast smirked and it stepped forward. Space folded around its massive body, and the creature vanished, reappearing directly behind Dexter.
Dexter’s eyes widened and before his conscious mind could process the threat. He spun backward, his saber sweeping upward in four rapid, desperate slashes.
"Ding! Ding! Ding! Ding!"

Four strikes, each one meeting one of the goblin’s four fists. The creature had launched all four arms simultaneously, each fist glowing with dense, emerald-green mana that had been condensed into solid, physical form.
The impacts sent tremors through Dexter’s entire body. The ground beneath his feet cracked and cratered as the reverberating force traveled through his legs and into the earth.
His arms shook as his jaw clenched. The difference in raw strength between a Seventh Stage Superhuman and a Third Level Ultra was staggering. Every blocked strike felt like being hit by a tank.
Then the beast grinned evilly.
Four blades materialized in its four hands, constructed of compressed mana, each one as sharp and durable as a physical weapon.
The creature didn’t waste a single motion as it launched a barrage of attacks, all four blades swinging at Dexter from different angles in a coordinated, relentless assault.
Dexter’s expression changed drastically as he overdrew Flame Burst Step, increasing his agility to be able to respond thickly.

chapters.title: Chapter 132 | Killing Three Ultra Class Monsters!
paragraphs: The beast’s attack flowed seamlessly, creating an endless, crushing barrage that gave Dexter no room to counterattack.
He was purely on the defensive.

But Flame Burst Step was still active. His speed was amplified by over 500%, and the Slaughter Extraction System had granted him substantial agility bonuses from the monsters he’d already killed. Combined with the physical enhancements from his body-tempering techniques, he was managing.
’This won’t do.’
Dexter realized. If this continued, he might actually be in trouble.
"How long?!" Dexter roared.
"Five more seconds!" Plasmatic roared back as his entire body now wreathed in blinding blue light. The plasma sphere between his palms had grown to the size of a basketball.
Five seconds."
Dexter gritted his teeth and continued to tank the assault. His saber moved in a blur, blocking, parrying, deflecting. The ground beneath him had been reduced to rubble. His arms burned.
Then the goblin commander suddenly glanced at Plasmatic Hero and its gaze hardened as it activated its skill.
"ROOOOOOOAAAAR!"

The sonic-mental assault erupted outward in a wave of devastating psychic pressure. Every hero within a ten-meter radius froze instantly, their minds disorientated as even two heroes collapsed and others stood still in confusion.
However, Dexter seemed to have expected it.
Like the saying goes. ’Bite me once shame on you, bite me twice, shame on me.’

The moment the roar began, he deactivated his Enhanced Hearing and detonated his Abyssal Emperor Flame. The deep violet fire blazed through his nervous system, incinerating the mental attack before it could do anything.
The Goblin Commander was still roaring, expecting everyone to be stunned.
Dexter didn’t waste the opening and vanished, reappearing directly behind the still-roaring creature. He immediately thrust forward with his entire strength.
"Puchi!"
The blade punched through the air and struck the creature’s back.
"Ding."
The saber had penetrated barely an inch when resistance materialized. A layer of dense, emerald mana barrier appeared beneath the beast’s skin, stopping the blade from reaching any vital organs.
Dexter’s eyes narrowed.
Ultra-level beings could condense mana into physical matter and that included protective barriers formed directly beneath their skin.
The beast was essentially wearing a suit of invisible, mana-forged armor.
The beast’s roar cut off abruptly as it registered the pain. Its crimson eyes widened with surprise and then shifted to pure, concentrated fury.
"ROOOOAR!"
It angrily spun around and all four swords swept in a devastating in multiple devastating arcs.
Dexter immediately tried to move but he wasn’t fast enough as one of the beast’s mana blades slices through his shirt and opening a deep gash across his ribs
Dexter hissed through clenched teeth but didn’t falter. He landed in a crouch, one hand pressed against his bleeding side, his dark red eyes locked on the beast.
"THREE SECONDS!" Plasmatic’s voice thundered across the battlefield.
The goblin commander seemed to have heard it too. Its crimson eyes flickered toward the plasma-glowing hero
It immediately turned away from Dexter and launched itself toward Plasmatic, all four mana blades raised, intending to kill him before he could release his attack.
Dexter immediately flicked his wrists and a hairpin needle stabbed through the air like a silent bullet.
The hairpin left his hand like a comet, as it rocketed toward the beast’s back.
The weapon’s built-in Aimlock accuracy found its mark, slamming into the same one-inch wound Dexter had already opened on the creature’s spine.
"Puchi!
Along with its penetrative ability, it stabbed even deeper this time.
The pain disrupted the beast’s spatial manipulation mid-step, causing it to stumble out of its folded space and materialize ten meters short of Plasmatic.
The beast roared in fury, pain and shock.
Just a bit more and needle would have pierced its heart. It slapped the needle away from its back.
"Everyone, duck!" Plasmatic roared as he released his attack.
Dexter didn’t hesitate. He dropped to the ground instantly. Every hero nearby followed suit.
The four-armed goblin commander was confused at first. Then its survival instincts screamed.
It tried to activate its spatial teleportation, folding space to escape whatever was coming.
But the gravity hero called Graviton among the group had already acted.
The air around the beast thickened instantly as gravitational force multiplied 10 fold. The goblin’s movements slowed drastically as if suddenly made of lead.
The slowdown lasted only 0.1 seconds.
That was all Plasmatic needed.
The hero’s chest plate split open, revealing a blinding core of concentrated plasma energy that had been charging for the past minute.

The energy erupted from his chest in a massive pillar of pure, white-hot light—a beam so intense that the air along its path ionized instantly, creating a vacuum corridor that the plasma traveled through at the speed of light itself.
The goblin face change it roared in fury and terror.
It immediately crossed all four forearms in front of its chest, activating its defensive technique.
Instantly, four layers of dense, green mana barriers materialized in front of it, each one thick enough to stop a Superhuman’s full-powered attack.
"Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!"
The four barriers disintegrated as the plasma beam punched through all four layers of defense and struck the beast’s chest with the force of a small star going supernova.
The beast managed to dodge slightly as a massive hole appeared in the right side of the Level three beast’s torso.
Its entire right shoulder and both right arms were destroyed cleanly—vaporized by the plasma energy, leaving behind a cauterized, steaming wound that exposed the creature’s internal organs.
But the beast was still alive.
"ROOOOOOAR—!"
It roar of pain was cut short as Dexter activated GodSlayer Flash.
"Crackle!"
Thunder crackled underneath his foot as another image of Dexter suddenly appeared behind the beast.
Two Dexter appearing simultaneously, all at once.
But then, one Dexter started to fade, it was actually an afterimage.
Dexter stood up straight and flicked the blood off his blade.
For a heartbeat, nothing happened. The beast stood motionless, its remaining arms still raised, its mouth still open mid-roar.
Then a thin line appeared around the goblin’s neck as its head toppled forward, hit the ground with a wet thunk and rolled twice before coming to rest against a piece of rubble.
The massive, headless body swayed for a moment, green blood fountaining from the severed neck, before collapsing forward with a ground-shaking crash.
[Extracted: +10 Strength, +8 Agility, +7 Physique, +5 Mana]
Dexter exhaled slowly.
The heroes around him let out a collective breath of relief.
"You did it!" one of them cheered, slapping Plasmatic on the back. "Nice! Well done!"
"Beautiful shot," another added, giving the plasma hero a thumbs up.
They turned to Dexter as well, offering grateful nods and thumbs-ups. "Good job stunning the beast," the speedster hero said, extending his hand.
Dexter shook the man’s hand briefly, then shook his head. "We need to help the others."
His voice cut through the celebration like a blade.
The heroes’ smiles faded instantly as they remembered the other Level four, Level Two, and Level One commanders were still active.
Kinetic Man and Bullet Spear was still holding the line against the Level Four’s remnants.
Dexter was already moving. "The Level two first. Same strategy."
The five heroes nodded.
The Level two commander was still engaged with its group of heroes when Dexter’s reinforced squad arrived.
Two of the heroes were already down, one unconscious, one bleeding from a head wound. The remaining three were barely holding.
Dexter assessed the situation in a single glance.
"Same setup!" he roared. "Gravity hero, slow it down! Plasmatic, charge! Rest of you, keep it contained!"
The heroes moved into position.
The Graviton extended both hands, and the air around the Level Two beast thickened. The creature’s movements slowed down as Dexter charged in.
He engaged the beast head-on, drawing its attention, forcing all four arms to focus on him.
Thirty seconds, Fourty-five seconds.
"NOW! DODGE!"
Dexter flashed sideways. The plasma beam erupted from Plasmatic’s chest for the second time, screaming across the battlefield at the speed of light.
This time, the Level Three beast couldn’t dodge as the beam struck its body and punched through the creature’s body like paper.
Dexter followed up with a slash, severing its head immediately.
The beast didn’t even know how it died as it collapsed.
[Extracted: +7 Strength, +6 Agility, +5 Physique, +3 Mana]
The heroes didn’t celebrate this time. They simply turned and ran toward the next target.
The Level One commander fell next.

With the full group of heroes now free to concentrate their forces, the strategy executed flawlessly. The gravity hero slowed the beast. Dexter drew its aggro, tanking its attacks with his tempered body while the other heroes created openings.
Plasmatic charged his beam. Almost a minute later, another smoking hole appeared in a goblin commander’s chest.
Kinetic Man and Bullet Spear Man had finished the Level Four beast at this time.
The market district fell silent.

All four commander beasts were dead. Their massive corpses littered the streets, green blood pooling beneath them in expanding lakes. The surviving heroes stood among the carnage, exhausted but alive.
Dexter leaned against a wrecked car, pressing his hand against the gash on his ribs. The wound had actually stopped bleeding by itself.
Moreover, he could actually see his wounds been healed rapidly, visible to the naked eyes.

Instantly, four layers of dense, green mana barriers materialized in front of it, each one thick enough to stop a Superhuman’s full-powered attack.
"Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!"
The four barriers disintegrated as the plasma beam punched through all four layers of defense and struck the beast’s chest with the force of a small star going supernova.
The beast managed to dodge slightly as a massive hole appeared in the right side of the Level three beast’s torso.
Its entire right shoulder and both right arms were destroyed cleanly—vaporized by the plasma energy, leaving behind a cauterized, steaming wound that exposed the creature’s internal organs.
But the beast was still alive.
"ROOOOOOAR—!"
It roar of pain was cut short as Dexter activated GodSlayer Flash.
"Crackle!"
Thunder crackled underneath his foot as another image of Dexter suddenly appeared behind the beast.
Two Dexter appearing simultaneously, all at once.
But then, one Dexter started to fade, it was actually an afterimage.
Dexter stood up straight and flicked the blood off his blade.
For a heartbeat, nothing happened.
The beast stood motionless, its remaining arms still raised, its mouth still open mid-roar.
Then a thin line appeared around the goblin’s neck as its head toppled forward, hit the ground with a wet thunk and rolled twice before coming to rest against a piece of rubble.
The massive, headless body swayed for a moment, green blood fountaining from the severed neck, before collapsing forward with a ground-shaking crash.
[Extracted: +10 Strength, +8 Agility, +7 Physique, +5 Mana]
Dexter exhaled slowly.
The heroes around him let out a collective breath of relief.
"You did it!" one of them cheered, slapping Plasmatic on the back.
"Nice!
Well done!"
"Beautiful shot," another added, giving the plasma hero a thumbs up.
They turned to Dexter as well, offering grateful nods and thumbs-ups.
"Good job stunning the beast," the speedster hero said, extending his hand.
Dexter shook the man’s hand briefly, then shook his head.
"We need to help the others."
His voice cut through the celebration like a blade.
The heroes’ smiles faded instantly as they remembered the other Level four, Level Two, and Level One commanders were still active.
Kinetic Man and Bullet Spear was still holding the line against the Level Four’s remnants.
Dexter was already moving.
"The Level two first.
Same strategy."
The five heroes nodded.
The Level two commander was still engaged with its group of heroes when Dexter’s reinforced squad arrived.
Two of the heroes were already down, one unconscious, one bleeding from a head wound.
The remaining three were barely holding.
Dexter assessed the situation in a single glance.
"Same setup!" he roared.
"Gravity hero, slow it down!
Plasmatic, charge!
Rest of you, keep it contained!"
The heroes moved into position.
The Graviton extended both hands, and the air around the Level Two beast thickened.
The creature’s movements slowed down as Dexter charged in.
He engaged the beast head-on, drawing its attention, forcing all four arms to focus on him.
Thirty seconds, Fourty-five seconds.
"NOW!
DODGE!"
Dexter flashed sideways.
The plasma beam erupted from Plasmatic’s chest for the second time, screaming across the battlefield at the speed of light.
This time, the Level Three beast couldn’t dodge as the beam struck its body and punched through the creature’s body like paper.
Dexter followed up with a slash, severing its head immediately.
The beast didn’t even know how it died as it collapsed.
[Extracted: +7 Strength, +6 Agility, +5 Physique, +3 Mana]
The heroes didn’t celebrate this time.
They simply turned and ran toward the next target.
The Level One commander fell next.
With the full group of heroes now free to concentrate their forces, the strategy executed flawlessly.
The gravity hero slowed the beast.
Dexter drew its aggro, tanking its attacks with his tempered body while the other heroes created openings.
Plasmatic charged his beam.
Almost a minute later, another smoking hole appeared in a goblin commander’s chest.
Kinetic Man and Bullet Spear Man had finished the Level Four beast at this time.
The market district fell silent.
All four commander beasts were dead.
Their massive corpses littered the streets, green blood pooling beneath them in expanding lakes.
The surviving heroes stood among the carnage, exhausted but alive.
Dexter leaned against a wrecked car, pressing his hand against the gash on his ribs.
The wound had actually stopped bleeding by itself.
Moreover, he could actually see his wounds been healed rapidly, visible to the naked eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 133 | Selene!
paragraphs: As the last Four-armed Goblin fell, the market district fell into a strange quiet.
The entire district had transformed into a battlefield, littered with goblin and human corpses alike.
Heroes were scattered across the streets, panting heavily. Some were kneeling beside fallen comrades, closing the eyes of the dead. Others were bandaging injuries.
At that moment, the popular female hero called Regen stated to go from one hero to another as she used her healing talent to heal the injured heroes.
Dexter stood in the middle of the street, his violet colored eyes reduced till it settled on dark with a hint of red.
If one looked closely, they would see he had three rings in his eyes: one dark, one red, and the third violet.
But the violet vanished like it wasn’t there, and the red ring faded till it was barely visible, leaving just the dark one.
His eyes looked into the mall where Aurora had vanished with the Goblin King.
"Boom!" "Boom!" "Boom!"
Sounds of battle still echoed inside the massive hall as Aurora and the Goblin King were still locked in battle.
Dexter frowned worriedly. If the Goblin King defeats her, then it might spell trouble for them.
All of a sudden, a resounding boom echoed from the ruins of the massive shopping mall.
"KA-BOOM!"
Shockwaves exploded out from the mall as half the massive mall collapsed instantly and the other half had its roof blown to bits.
An entire freaking mall had actually been reduced to rubble just like that!
The earth-shaking impacts finally ceased, and 10 seconds later, space warped as Aurora appeared in the air above the destroyed building.
The entire mall had been devastated—half of it had collapsed entirely, and the remaining half was reduced to a single wall.
Aurora hovered for a moment as her silver floated in the sunlight. In her right hand was the severed head of the Six-Armed Goblin King, dripping blood.
She casually threw it to the ground.
"Thud."
The massive head hit the pavement, rolling slightly before coming to rest in a pool of green blood.
"Whoohoo!"
The surrounding heroes erupted into cheers and whistles. The nightmare was over, and the boss was dead.
Aurora didn’t smile. She turned and flew directly into the still-open gate. She was gone for barely a minute before she emerged again.
In her hand, she now held a treasure chest, the dungeon core. She had gone in to claim it, and this would ensure that the dungeon would never reopen.
As she landed on the ground, the spatial rift behind her began to shrink, its edges folding inward until it vanished with a soft pop.
The heroes cheered even louder. Aurora nodded at the group. Her gaze swept over the crowd, landing on Kinetic Man and Bullet Spear Man.
She gave them a curt nod.
"Well done," she said to Kinetic Man. "You held the line."
Kinetic Man smiled, nodding his head in acknowledgment, though he was clearly exhausted.
Then, Aurora turned her head. Her eyes found Dexter standing alone in the middle of the street.
She began to walk toward him. The heroes parted ways for her.
Aurora’s face was indifferent through which a small apologetic smile touched her lips.
She then opened her mouth to speak. "I apologize for earlier—"
Aurora froze. Her words died in her throat as Dexter raised a hand all of a sudden to shush her.
Dexter’s face changed dramatically as his eyes widened and his expression transformed into one of panic.
He didn’t look at her as his head snapped towards a particular direction!
Frost Sense was ringing!
"Selene!"
Aurora’s gaze turned cold. She opened her mouth to say something when Dexter exploded with Flame Burst Step and Godslayer Flash!
The ground beneath him shattered into pieces!
"Crackle!"
Blue thunder erupted around his right leg.
’Whoosh!’
Violet flames exploded around his left leg.
He combined Thunder Manipulation and Flame Burst Step, transforming into a blurring streak of blue and violet light as he dashed straight for his parked Vanguard V4.
The moment his hand touched the metal frame, he willed it into his storage ring.
The vehicle vanished in a flash of golden light.
He didn’t stop. He rocketed into a secluded alley between two collapsed buildings, hidden from the eyes of the heroes and Aurora.
He threw his arm out.
Golden light flashed, and a normal-looking family-type SUV materialized on the ground. The Type-6 vehicle!
Dexter yanked the door open, dove into the driver’s seat, and slammed his hand on the ignition.

The arcane engine roared to life, humming with terrifying power. He reached into his storage ring, pulled out a glowing green nexus core he had harvested from a goblin corpse, and shoved it into the mana-fuel slot beside the steering wheel.
The console blazed to life.
"Flight mode activated," a mechanical voice chimed.
The SUV’s chassis shifted. Hidden panels retracted, and two massive jet thrusters deployed from the undercarriage. Four smaller, directional thrusters unfolded from the sides.
Dexter gripped the wheel. "Go!"
"BOOM!"

The jet engines ignited with a deafening roar, unleashing a massive shockwave that blew the brick walls of the alley apart. The Type-6 SUV shot into the sky like a bullet, leaving a trail of blue fire in its wake.
Dexter pushed the engine to its maximum speed. The city blurred beneath him as he crossed districts in seconds.
In less than a minute, he arrived home.
The moment he reached the corner heading to his street, he killed the thrusters and descended into a nearby alley. The jet engines retracted, the chassis shifted, and four armored tires deployed.
He didn’t even wait for the landing gear to fully lock before slamming the accelerator.
"Vrooom!"
The SUV screamed out of the alley as he drifted around the final corner and screeched to a halt directly in front of his bungalow.
He didn’t turn off the engine nor did he close the door. He burst out of the vehicle and sprinted toward the house.

chapters.title: Chapter 134 | Abyssal Emperor Heavenly Flame Might
paragraphs: The front door was already open and cold air could be seen seeping out in forget like foggy smoke.
He crashed into the living room. The air inside was so cold that his breath crystallized instantly into thick, white plumes.
The girls weren’t in the living room.
Dexter’s Enhanced Hearing tracked them to the hallway. He burst through the corridor and found Mira, Lyra, and Tessa standing at the entrance of the bedroom, their faces pale with worry.
Tessa.
Dexter was stunned to see the baker’s daughter standing there.
’The hell she’s doing here?’
But he couldn’t afford to ask why she was there.
He looked past them and into the bedroom.
Selene lay on her bed.
The entire mattress had been frozen solid into a block of pure, translucent ice that coated her body like a crystalline coffin.
The frost had spread outward from the bed, consuming the walls, the ceiling, the floor, and had already covered Mira and Lyra’s beds on either side.
The room was a frozen wasteland. The temperature was so low that the very air seemed to burn with cold.
The moment she saw him, Lyra’s voice exploded in his mind.
"I searched everywhere for the suppressant serum! I couldn’t find it anywhere!"
Mira didn’t speak. She simply glared at Dexter, her crimson eyes burning in a slightt accusatory tone.
Tessa stared at him in shock. ’Was this what Dexter deals with every day?’
Dexter didn’t have the time nor the luxury to say anything or explain himself.
The moment he stepped inside, he simply exploded with a wave of energy.
The Abyssal Emperor Flame erupted from his body like a hurricane as deep violet fire blazed outward from every fiber of his being.
As the flames erupted, the ice immediately started to recede, melting and evaporating at the same time.
"Tsssssssssssssssss!"
The frost on the hallway walls vanished instantly upon contact with the violet fire, transforming directly from solid to gas in a hissing burst of steam.
The air itself seemed to part before him, the cold retreating like a subject bowing before an emperor.
Dexter walked forward.
Each step melted the frozen floorboards beneath his feet. The ice parted before him in perfect, circular waves, steam rising in elegant spirals around his body.
He approached Selene’s ice-encased bed. The frozen coffin around her body was thick—easily six inches of solid, mana-infused ice that pulsed with the hostile, parasitic energy of the Eternal Winter.
Dexter placed his hand on the ice.
The Abyssal Emperor Flame surged.
"CRACK!"
The ice instantly cracked as the molecular structure of the frozen water simply broke apart. Chunks of ice fell away from Selene’s body, melting into steam before they could hit the mattress.
The frost on the walls, the ceiling, the other beds, all of it retreated, evaporating into clouds of white vapor that drifted out through the window.
Within seconds, the room was clear.
Selene lay on the bed, her skin ghostly pale, her lips blue, her silver hair damp from the melted ice. Her breathing was shallow and erratic, her chest barely rising.
Dexter flicked his right hand. A syringe materialized in his palm; the Grade-3 Eternal Frost Suppressant Serum appeared from his system storage.
He stabbed it directly into Selene’s arm.
"Click."
The serum discharged into her bloodstream. The warm, golden liquid spread through her veins, fighting back the parasitic cold energy that had nearly consumed her from the inside out.
Dexter felt the needle pierce his own skin simultaneously as the Ring of Shared Burdens transferred the pain to him as it always did, but he barely registered it. He was focused entirely on Selene.
He placed both hands on her body, channeling the Abyssal Emperor Flame through his palms and into her skin. The warmth was gentle.
And his control was perfect. He was a Great Grandmaster Foodsmith Afterall; manipulating flames was his specialty.
The violet fire carefully seeped into her meridians, countering the Eternal Winter’s parasitic cold at its source.
Her breathing gradually steadied. The blue faded from her lips as color slowly returned to her cheeks.
If she wasn’t resistant to Ice, she would have definitely died five times over.
Dexter stayed beside her, kneeling on the floor, his hands resting on her arm as he continued to pump controlled warmth into her body.
In the hallway, three pairs of eyes stared at Dexter with various expressions on their faces.
Lyra’s eyes were wide with astonishment. She had never seen Dexter use a flame talent before.
The man she had married, the quiet, unassuming house husband who cooked their meals and took care of them was currently blasting out violet flames so intense he looked like a flame god!
She had thought he might have been talentless but knew something wasn’t right when Dexter killed those two assassins.
Now she definitely knew his talent wasn’t worse than hers.
Mira’s reaction was different.
Her brows were furrowed as she stared at Dexter.
’Heavenly Flame?’

The Crimson Flame-Heart was an S-rank ability that had once made her the youngest S-rank hero in the city. She was obsessed with all types of flames and she could feel the one around Dexter wasn’t ordinary.
The heat radiating from his body was far, far hotter than her own S-rank flame talent.
If she had to grade it, she would grade it S-rank at minimum. Possibly higher.
But Dexter was supposed to be F-rank. The useless, talentless bastard son of the Ashford family. An F-rank mana affinity that would never amount to anything.
’If he has an F-rank talent, then what were these flames? Was it a second talent? Or did he actually manage to get his hands on a Heavenly Flame?’
She was quite surprised.
Dexter had shocked them again and again, and each revelation was more impossible than the last, to the point that the surprise was even starting to fade.
She had already suspected he had a powerful backing. This simply confirmed it.
Tessa stood further back from the other two girls, her green eyes locked on Dexter’s flaming silhouette with undisguised shock.
’Is this the useless bastard son of the Ashford family?’
The heat radiating from his body was oppressive even from the hallway.
’He actually possesses such high level talent and a high-level Heavenly Flame too’
It was as though she could see right through him the moment he exploded with the flame.
’What was the Ashford family thinking, discarding someone like this? As expected of a backwater family.’Her lips curled as she shook her head, a mischievous glint in her eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 | Sigh, Women Are So Confusing
paragraphs: Dexter continued warming Selene’s body until he was certain she was stable. He slowly withdrew his hands, extinguishing the Abyssal Emperor Flame, and exhaled a long breath of exhaustion.
He had been battling for the past hour and rushing here without resting, along with being worried about Selene, which added to his exhaustion.
’Thank God I came early. I don’t know what would have happened if I’d been a minute later.’
He almost slapped himself.
In the excitement of the monster outbreak, the emergency alert, the argument with Mira, amongst other things, he had completely forgotten what he planned to do after the meal.
He had planned to inject Selene with the new Grade-3 Eternal Frost Suppressant Serum after breakfast.
But after the sudden emergency, it escaped his mind, leaving Selene vulnerable to another attack.
The old serum had worn off days ago. The new one sat in his storage ring the entire time he was fighting goblins, completely forgotten.
It was his fault—all of it.
If he had been more responsible, taking five seconds to inject the serum before leaving, Selene wouldn’t have nearly frozen to death.
His jaw clenched, and he sighed as he slowly stood up, intending to leave the bedroom and let her rest.
But the moment he shifted his weight, a small, icy hand shot out and grabbed his arm.
Dexter froze.

Selene, still fast asleep, pulled his arm toward her with surprising strength. She hugged it tightly against her chest, wrapping both of her arms around it and pressing her cheek against his skin, clinging to him like a child holding a teddy bear.

Dexter was stunned. He immediately dialed back the active, visible flames of the Abyssal Emperor Flame. Still, he kept the internal heat radiating from his body, knowing she needed the warmth to stave off any residual frost energy.
However, a major dilemma presented itself.
His entire body was caked in blood, sweat, and gore.
He had just returned from a battlefield, and his clothes were torn and stained with green goblin blood and his own red blood.
Mira slowly wheeled her self into the bedroom, using her spectral arms. She glanced at Selene clinging to Dexter, then her crimson eyes traveled down Dexter’s body.
"You are injured," she stated indifferently.
Dexter looked down at himself. He had almost forgotten about his injury.
There was a deep gash on his ribs from the Level Three goblin commander; although it had stopped bleeding, it was still healing.
Dexter smiled awkwardly. "It’s just superficial injuries. Don’t be worried about me."

Mira immediately snorted, her eyes narrowing. "Who is worried about you? I’m only worried you’re going to end up getting infected. Once you’re infected, you won’t be able to take care of us any longer. "
With that, she turned her wheelchair around and began to leave. As she passed Lyra in the doorway, she paused as she said, projecting her thoughts. "You should help him clean his wounds. I can’t."
Lyra nodded her head slowly. ’Okay.’
Her voice echoed in Mira’s mind. She then turned and headed toward the kitchen to fetch the medical kit.
While Lyra was gone, Dexter turned his attention to the other person still lingering in the room.
He frowned. "What are you doing here?"

Tessa smiled, casually leaning against the doorframe. "I was playing chess with Grandma Lucy opposite your house when she sensed something. I thought they were under attack, so I came in. I didn’t expect this scene."
Dexter’s frown deepened. His eyes locked onto her with sharp suspicion. "The formation didn’t stop you?"
Tessa innocently blinked her green eyes. "What formation?"
Dexter stared at her. She looked completely genuine, but he knew she was lying. The Type-5 House Protection Talisman was fully active and intact.
It restricted even space itself, and even Transcendent Experts can’t enter.
Yet Tessa had walked right through it as if it didn’t exist, without breaking the formation.
*What kind of monster is this girl?* Dexter thought as his face turned slightly grim.
He had no idea what this little girl’s intentions were, but if she wanted to harm them, not even the formation could help.
But now wasn’t the time to interrogate the baker’s daughter.
"Thanks for your help," Dexter said. "And thank Grandma Lucy for me. You can leave now."
Tessa blinked as she stared at Dexter for a moment, then nodded and pushed off the doorframe. "Anytime." She flashed him a brilliant smile, turned, and skipped out of the room.
A minute later, Lyra returned with a white medical box, a bowl of warm water, and a clean cloth. She walked towards him and sat down on the edge of Selene’s bed.
Lyra opened the medical box and began pulling out supplies: a bottle of ethanol, cotton wool, and bandages. Then, without asking his permission, she picked up a pair of scissors from the kit.
"RIIIIIIIIIIIIIP!!!"
Dexter’s torn, blood-soaked shirt fell away in two pieces, dropping to the floor and revealing his muscular but bloody body.
Dexter blinked. "...That was my nice shirt."
Lyra ignored him completely. Her expression was frigid, her dark eyes entirely devoid of their usual softness.
She soaked a piece of cotton wool with antiseptic ethanol and reached out, gently but firmly pressing it against the deep gash on his ribs.
Dexter winced, his muscles tensing involuntarily as the stinging alcohol bit into the open wound. "Ah..."
Lyra didn’t react.
She continued dabbing the injury, cleaning away the dried blood, then she moved to the cuts on his chest,
She then dipped the clean cloth into the warm water, wiping away the layers of green goblin blood, sweat, and dirt that coated his torso, face, and arms.
Despite her gentle care, her face remained incredibly cold.
’She seems mad.’
Dexter blinked as he saw her face.
Dexter scratched his chin awkwardly, then spoke.
"I’m sorry, all right? See, it’s nothing serious. It’s just superficial wounds. "
Lyra did not reply, nor did she look him in the eye. She just kept wiping the blood from his abdomen, with her jaw clenched tight.
Dexter sighed. He racked his brain, trying to figure out how to break through this icy wall of anger.
Suddenly, an idea popped into his head. He flipped his right hand, and a golden light flashed.
A Celestial Moon Pastry materialized in his palm, perfectly baked, glowing faintly with mana and smelling absolutely divine.
"Here," Dexter said softly, holding it out to her. "I bought this for you on the way."
Lyra’s nose flared. Her dark eyes locked onto the pastry, and for the first time since she had entered the room, they lit up.
The pastry looked incredible, and the aroma was tantalizing. Just smelling it, she could tell it would be the best thing she had ever tasted.
She stared at it, her eyes wide with desire for a while. But then, Lyra shook her head violently.
She tore her gaze away from the pastry, glared at Dexter angrily, then grabbed the bowl of warm water and the medical kit, stood up, and marched out of the room.
"Bang!"
The door slammed shut as she angrily walked out.
Dexter was left sitting on the edge of the bed, shirtless, covered in half-cleaned blood, with a pastry in his right hand.
On the bed beside him, Selene shifted, hugging his arm tighter and letting out a soft, contented sigh.
Dexter looked down at the pastry, then at the closed door, and let out a long, heavy sigh.
"Women," he muttered under his breath. "So confusing."
